verses.text: U Trai U la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri kynjah Sinai, ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u ba-ar, ha ka snem ka ba-ar hadien ba ki la mih na ri Ijipt, U ong,
“To shim jingkheiñ ïa ka kynhun baroh jong u paid Israel, shikur shikur, shikpa shikpa tymmen, da kaba ñiew ïa ki kyrteng jong ki shynrang baroh, shikhlieh shikhlieh.
Ïa kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, ïa ki kynja Israel baroh kiba la tbit ban leit thma, ma phi bad u Aron phi dei ban ñiew, shikynhun kynhun.
Dei ban don ryngkat bad phi uwei u rangbah na kawei kawei ka jait, uta u rangbah u dei ban long u khlieh duh jong ka ïing ka sem ki kpa tymmen jong u.
“Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong kita ki rangbah kiban ïarap kam ïa phi. Na ka jait u Reuben, u Elisur u khun u Shedeur;
na ka jait u Simeon, u Shelumiel, u khun u Zurishaddai;
na ka jait u Juda, u Nahshon, u khun u Amminadab;
na ka jait u Issakhar, u Nethanel u khun u Zuwar;
na ka jait u Zebulun, u Eliab, u khun u Helon;
na ki khun u Joseph, na ka jait u Ephraim, u Elishama u khun u Ammihud, bad na ka jait u Manasse, u Gamaliel u khun u Pedasur;
na ka jait u Benjamin, u Abidan u khun u Gideoni;
na ka jait u Dan, u Ahieser u khun u Ammishaddai;
na ka jait u Asher, u Pakiel u khun u Okhran;
na ka jait u Gad, u Eliasaph u khun u Dewel;
na ka jait u Naphtali, u Ahira u khun u Enan.”
Kine ki long kita ki briew ïa kiba la jied na ka kynhun paidbah; ki long ki rangbah duh jong ki ïingkur shikpa shikpa tymmen, ki kynja nongïalam jong ki jait Israel.
Te u Moses bad u Aron ki la shim ïa kine ki briew ba la jied,

bad ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u ba-ar, ki la lum lang ïa u paid baroh shi kynhun. Kine ki la ai kyrteng ïa lade shikur shikur, shikpa shikpa tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki uwei uwei naduh kiba arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, shikhlieh shikhlieh,
kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses. Kumta u la ñiew ïa ki ha ri kynjah Sinai.

Ïa ki paid jong u Reuben, u khun nyngkong jong u Israel, la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Reuben ki don sawphew hynriew hajar sanspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid jong u Simeon la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Simeon ki don sanphew khyndai hajar laispah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Gad, la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Gad ki don sawphew san hajar hynriewspah sanphew ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Juda la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Juda ki don hynñiewphew saw hajar hynriewspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Issakhar la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Issakhar, ki don sanphewsaw hajar sawspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Zebulun la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Zebulun, ki don sanphew hynñiew hajar sawspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Joseph, kata ka mut ïa ki paid u Ephraim, la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Ephraim, ki don sawphew hajar sanspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Manasse la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit ban leit thma.
Haba ñiew ïa kiba na ka jait u Manasse, ki don laiphew ar hajar arspah ngut.

Ïa kiba na ka jait u Benjamin la ñiew ha la ki pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit ban leit thma.
Haba ñiew ïa kiba na ka jait u Benjamin, ki don laiphew san hajar sawspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Dan la ñiew ha la ka pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ka kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Dan, ki don hynriewphew ar hajar hynñiew spah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Asher la ñiew ha la ka pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Asher, ki don sawphew wei hajar sanspah ngut.

Ïa ki paid u Naphtali la ñiew ha la ka pateng-pateng, shikur-shikur, shikpa-shikpa-tymmen, katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khlieh shynrang, kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, bad kiba tbit baroh ban leit thma.
Haba kheiñ ïa kiba na ka jait u Naphtali, ki don sanphew lai hajar sawspah ngut.
Kine ki long kita ïa kiba la shim jingkheiñ, ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aron ki la kheiñ da ka jingïarap lem jong ki rangbah duh ki Israel khat-ar ngut, uwei uwei u mihkhmat ïa la ka ïingkur.
Kumta la kheiñ kyllum ïa ki paid Israel baroh, katkum ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki, ïa kiba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng bad ïa ki shynrang baroh kiba ha Israel kiba tbit ban leit thma—
haba kheiñ kyllum lang baroh ki don hynriewspah lai hajar sanspah sanphew ngut.
Hynrei ïa ki Lebi ym shym don jingkheiñ da ka jingïadei kur dei jait kumba leh ïa kiwei.
Naba u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“Tang ïa ki jait u Lebi phin ym shim jingkheiñ, bad phin ym dei ban kheiñ ïa ki kumba leh ïa ki paid Israel baroh.

To thung ïa ki ban peit ïa ka tabernakyl jong ki Hukum, ban peit ïa ki jingpynriam jong ka, bad ban peit ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh. Ki dei ban rah ïa ka tabernakyl bad ïa ki jingpynriam jong ka baroh. Ki dei ban sumar ïa ka, bad ki dei ban shong dara sawdong ka tabernakyl.

Haba ka tabernakyl ka dei ban kynriah jaka, ki Lebi ki dei ban loit ïa ka; haba dei ban pynïeng ïa ka tabernakyl, ki Lebi ki dei ban shna ïa ka. Lada uno uno uwei pat u briew u wan tur shajan, ïa u dei ban pynïap.
Ki paid Israel ki dei ban sher ïa la ki dara ha la ki kynhun kynhun, man la u briew ha la kajong ka ïing dara, man la u briew hajan la kajong ka lama.

Tang ki Lebi kin shong dara sawdong ka tabernakyl jong ki Hukum, khnang ba ka jingbitar u Blei kan ym wan hap halor ka kynhun jong ki paid Israel. Dei ki Lebi kiban sumar ïa ka tabernakyl jong ki Hukum.”
Ki paid Israel ki la leh thik kumta; ki la leh baroh kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses bad u Aron,
“Ki paid Israel kin shong dara man la u briew hajan la kajong ka lama, hapoh ki dakshynna jong la ki ïingkur; kin shong dara marpyrshah ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh baroh sawdong.

Kito ki ban shong dara na shaphang mihngi, na ka dong ba mih ka sngi, ki dei kiba hapoh ka lama jong ka dara u Juda, shikynhun kynhun. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Juda u long u Nahshon, u khun u Amminadab.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long hynñiewphew saw hajar hynriew spah ngut.
Kito kiban shong dara hajan jong u kin long kiba na ka jait u Issakhar; u rangbah duh jong ki paid u Issakhar u long u Nethanel, u khun u Zuwar.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sanphew saw hajar sawspah ngut.
Nangta bud sa ka jait u Zebulun. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Zebulun u long u Eliab u khun u Helon.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sanphew hynñiew hajar sawspah ngut.
Ka jingkheiñ kyllum ïa ka dara u Juda, ha la ki kynhun kynhun, ka long shispah phraphew hynriew hajar sawspah ngut. Ma ki kin mih nyngkong ha ka jingïaid.
“Shaphang shathie, yn don ka lama jong ka dara u Reuben ha la ka kynhun kynhun. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Reuben u long u Elisur u khun u Shedeur.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sawphew hynriew hajar sanspah ngut.
Kito kiba shong dara marjan bad u kin long ka jait u Simeon. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Simeon u long u Shelumiel u khun u Zurishaddai.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sanphew khyndai hajar laispah ngut.
Nangta bud sa ka jait u Gad. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Gad u long u Eliasaph u khun u Rewel.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sawphew san hajar hynriewspah sanphew ngut.
Ka jingkheiñ kyllum ïa ka dara u Reuben, ha la ki kynhun kynhun, ka long shispah sanphew wei hajar sawspah sanphew ngut. Kin bud sa kine ban mih.
“Nangta yn mih sa ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh; ka dara jong ki Lebi kan don hapdeng ki ïing dara. Kumba ki shong dara, kumta ruh kin mih, man la u briew ha la ka jaka jaka, hapoh la ka lama lama.
“Na shaphang sepngi, yn don ka lama jong ka dara u Ephraim ha la ka kynhun kynhun. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Ephraim u long u Elishama u khun u Ammihud.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sawphew hajar sanspah ngut.
Mar bud ïa u yn don ka jait u Manasse. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Manasse u long u Gamaliel u khun u Pedasur.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew laiphew ar hajar arspah ngut.
Bud nangta sa ka jait u Benjamin. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Benjamin u long u Abidan u khun u Gideoni,
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long laiphewsan hajar sawspah ngut.
Ka jingkheiñ kyllum ïa ka dara u Ephraim, ha la ki kynhun kynhun, ka long shispah phra hajar shispah ngut. Kine kin long ki balai ban mih ha ka jingïaid.
“Na shaphang shatei, yn don ka lama jong ka dara u Dan ha la ka kynhun kynhun. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Dan u long u Ahieser u khun u Ammishaddai.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long hynriewphew ar hajar hynñiewspah ngut.
Ki bashong dara marjan bad u ki long kiba na ka jait u Asher. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Asher u long u Pakiel u khun u Okhran.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sawphew wei hajar sanspah ngut.
Nangta bud sa ka jait u Naphtali. U rangbah duh jong ki paid u Naphtali u long u Ahira u khun u Enan.
Ki paid thma jong u kumba la kheiñ briew ki long sanphew lai hajar sawspah ngut.
Ka jingkheiñ kyllum ïa ka dara u Dan ka long shispah sanphew hynñiew hajar hynriewspah ngut. Kine kin mih khatduh, ha la ka lama lama.”

Kine ki long ki paid Israel kumba la kheiñ katkum la ki jong ki jong ki ïingkur jong ki. Haba kheiñ ïa kiba don baroh ha ki jaka shong dara ha la ki kynhun kynhun ki la long hynriewspah lai hajar sanspah sanphew ngut.
Ïa ki Lebi te ym shym kheiñ lang bad ki paid Israel, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.

Kumne ki paid Israel ki la leh thik kumba u Trai u la ai hukum ha u Moses. Ki la shong dara katkum la ki lama, bad kumta ki la mih, man la u briew bad la ka ïing ka sem, ha la kajong kajong ka ïingkur.
Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aron bad u Moses ha ka por mynba u Trai U la kren bad u Moses halor u lum Sinai.
Ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang u Aron ki long kine: u Nadab u khun nyngkong, nangta u Abihu, u Eleaser bad u Ithamar.
Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang u Aron, ki lyngdoh ba la ïoh jingpynsleh, ïa kiba u la pynkup bor ban shakri ha ka kam lyngdoh.

U Nadab bad u Abihu ki la ïap hakhmat u Trai haba ki la tyrwa da ka ding ka bymkhuid hakhmat u Trai ha ri kynjah Sinai; kim shym don khun ei ei. Kumta u Eleaser bad u Ithamar ki la shakri kum ki lyngdoh katba dang im u Aron u kpa jong ki.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To wan ïalam lang ïa kiba na ka jait u Lebi, bad thung ïa ki ban shakri hakhmat u Aron lyngdoh.
Ki dei ban pyndep ki kamram na ka bynta jong u bad na ka bynta ka kynhun baroh kawei hakhmat ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh haba ki shakri ha ka tabernakyl.
Ki dei ban sumar ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ban pyndep ïa ki kamram na ka bynta ki paid Israel haba ki shakri ha ka tabernakyl.
Te phi dei ban aiti ïa ki Lebi ha u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u; ïa ki la aiti baroh shitylli ha u napdeng ki paid Israel.
Kumta phi dei ban thung kam ïa u Aron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u, bad ki dei ban kit khia tang ïa ka kam lyngdoh. Ïa uno uno uwei pat u briew uba shlan ban wan tur shajan, dei ban pynïap.”
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses,
“Hakhmih, Nga la shim ïa ki Lebi napdeng ki paid Israel ha ka jaka jong u khun phrangsngi baroh hapdeng ki paid Israel. Ki Lebi ki dei ki jong Nga,

naba ki khun phrangsngi baroh ki long ki jong Nga. Ha ka sngi ba Nga la pynïap ïa ki khun phrangsngi ha ri Ijipt, Nga la pynkyntang kum la ki jong ïa ki khun phrangsngi baroh kiba ha Israel, ki jong u briew bad ki jong u mrad. Ki dei ban long ki jong Nga: Nga Nga long u Trai.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses ha ri kynjah Sinai,
“To kheiñ ïa ki khun shynrang u Lebi, katkum ki ïingkur bad ki ïing ki sem jong ki; ïa u shynrang baroh uba naduh shibnai ka ryta bad shaneng phi dei ban kheiñ.”
Kumta u Moses u la kheiñ ïa ki katkum ka ktien kaba u Trai U la hukum ïa u.
Kine ki long ki khun shynrang u Lebi da ki kyrteng jong ki: u Gershon, u Kohath bad u Merari.
Kine pat ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang u Gershon shikur shikur: u Libni bad u Shimei.
Ki khun shynrang u Kohath shikur shikur: U Amram, u Ishar, u Hebron, bad u Ussiel.
Ki khun shynrang u Merari shikur shikur: u Mali bad u Mushi. Kine ki long kita ki ïingkur jong ki Lebi, shikpa shikpa tymmen.
Na u Gershon la mih ka ïingkur u Libni bad ka ïingkur u Shimei; kine ki long ki jait Gershon.
Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki, katba don ki shynrang baroh kiba naduh shibnai ka ryta bad shaneng, ka la long hynñiew hajar sanspah ngut.
Ki jait Gershon ki dei ban shong dara shadien ka tabernakyl shaphang sepngi,
hajuh bad u Eliasaph, u khun u Lael kum u khlieh duh jong ka ïingkur ki jait Gershon.
Ka kamram jong ki khun shynrang u Gershon ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ka la long ka tabernakyl, ka ïing jaiñ bad ka jynsop jong ka, ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh,
ki jynwah ka phyllaw, ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jynkhang jong ka phyllaw kaba tawiar ïa ka tabernakyl bad ka duwan, bad ki tyllai jong ka; bad kano kano ka kam kaba ïadei bad kine.
Na u Kohath la mih ka ïingkur Amram, ka ïingkur Ishar, ka ïingkur Hebron bad ka ïingkur Ussiel; kine ki long kita ki jait Kohath.
Katkum ka jingkheiñ ïa ki shynrang baroh kiba naduh shi bnai bad shaneng, la don phra hajar hynriewspah ngut kiba don ki kamram ban pyndep ha ka jaka kyntang.
Ki ïingkur jong ki khun shynrang u Kohath ki dei ban shong dara ha ka dong kaba shaphang shathie jong ka tabernakyl,
hajuh bad u Elisaphan u khun u Ussiel kum u khlieh duh jong ki ïingkur kiba na ka jait Kohath.

Kine ki dei ban peit ïa ka synduk, ïa ka miej, ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak, ïa ki duwan, ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka jaka kyntang kiba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban pyndonkam haba lehniam bad ïa ka pyrda; baroh ki kam kiba ïadei bad kine.
U Eleasar u khun jong u Aron lyngdoh u dei ban long u rangbah duh halor ki rangbah Lebi, bad u dei ban peit ïa kito kiba don ka kam ban trei ha ka jaka kyntang.
Na u Merari la mih ka ïingkur Mali bad ka ïingkur Mushi; kine ki long ka jait Merari.
Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki, katba don ki shynrang baroh kiba naduh shibnai bad shaneng, ka la long hynriew hajar arspah ngut.
U khlieh duh jong ka ïingkur jong ki jait Merari u la long u Zuriel u khun u Abihail; ki dei ban shong dara ha ka dong kaba shaphang shatei jong ka tabernakyl.
Ka kam ba la buh ïa ki khun shynrang u Merari ka la long ki jynker jong ka tabernakyl, ki diengkhap, ki rijied, ki thliew shanam bad ki tiar kiba ïadei bad kine; kano kano ka kam kaba ïadei bad kine;
nangta ki rijied jong ka phyllaw baroh sawdong, lem bad ki syngkhien, ki prek bad ki tyllai jong ki.

Kito kiba dei ban shong dara hakhmat ka tabernakyl na shaphang mihngi, hakhmat ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh shaphang ba mih ka sngi, dei u Moses bad u Aron lem bad ki khun shynrang jong u, kiba dei ban peit ïa ki riti niam ha ka jaka kyntang, katba don kano kano ka kam ban leh na ka bynta ki paid Israel. Ïa uno uno uwei pat u briew uba wan tur shajan, dei ban pynïap.
Baroh kat kiba la kheiñ na ki Lebi, ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aron ki la kheiñ da ka hukum u Trai, shikur shikur, baroh ki shynrang kiba shibnai ka ryta bad shaneng, ki la long aphew ar hajar ngut.
U Trai U la ong ha u Moses, “To shim jingkheiñ ïa ki shynrang baroh ba kha nyngkong jong ki paid Israel, kiba naduh shibnai bad shaneng; kheiñ ïa ki da ka kyrteng.

Phin shim ïa ki Lebi na ka bynta jong Nga, u Trai, ha ka jaka jong ki khun phrangsngi napdeng ki paid Israel, bad ïa ki jynri jong ki Lebi ha ka jaka jong ki khun phrangsngi na ki jynri jyndup jong ki paid Israel.”
Kumta u Moses u la kheiñ ïa ki khun phrangsngi baroh jong ki paid Israel, kumba u Trai u la ai hukum ïa u.
Baroh ki shynrang ba kha nyngkong jong ki paid Israel, katkum ka jingkheiñ da ki kyrteng, naduh kiba shibnai bad shaneng, ki la long arphew ar hajar arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To shim ïa ki Lebi ha ka jaka ki khun phrangsngi napdeng ki paid Israel, bad ïa ki jynri jong ki Lebi ha ka jaka jong ki jynri jong ki; ki Lebi ki dei ki jong Nga: ma Nga Nga long u Trai.
Te na ka bynta ka jingsiewspah ïa ki arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut, ki khun phrangsngi na ki paid Israel kiba tam ïa ki Lebi shynrang,
phi dei ban shim mar san shekel uwei uwei; pynshong katkum ka dor shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, arphew kera shi shekel.
To ai ha u Aron bad ki khun phrangsngi jong u ïa ka pisa ba ïoh na ka jingsiewspah ïa ki briew kiba tam.”
Kumta u Moses u la shim ïa ka pisa jingsiewspah na kito kiba tam ba la siewspah da ki Lebi.
Na ki khun phrangsngi jong ki paid Israel u la shim pisa shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel, haba pynshong katkum ka dor shekel jong ka jaka kyntang.
U Moses u la ai ïa ka pisa jingsiewspah ha u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, katkum ka ktien u Trai, kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.
U Trai U la ong ha u Moses bad u Aron,
“To shim jingkheiñ ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Kohath napdeng ki Lebi, shikur shikur katkum ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki,
ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh kiba sanphew snem ka ryta ïa kito baroh kiba tbit ban rung kam shakri, ban trei kam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
Ka kam jong ki khun ki ksiew u Kohath ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ka long kane: kiei kiei ki bakhuid tam.
Haba ka kynhun shong dara ka dei ban mih noh, u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin leit ban law noh ïa ka pyrda jong ka jynkah, bad kin sop da ka ïa ka synduk jong ka Sakhi.
Nangta kin tap ïa ka nalor da ka kynja snieh blang, bad sa halor kata kin phriang kawei ka jaiñ jngum,bad kin phrung ïa ki dieng ban bah ïa ka.

“Halor ka miej jong u kpu-tyrwa kin siang kawei ka jaiñ ka bajngum, kin buh halor jong ka ïa ki pliang, ki jyndiang dhup, ki dabor, bad ki khiew tyrwa jyndih; u kpu tyrwa uba don barabor un don ruh halor jong ka.
Halor jong kine kin phriang kawei ka jaiñ sawsyngiang, bad kin tap nalor kine sa ka snieh blang, nangta kin phrung ïa ki dieng ban bah ïa ka.
“Nangta kin shim kawei ka jaiñ jngum bad kin sop ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak lang bad ki sharak jong ka, ki khaiñshi jong ka, ki pliang ding jong ka, bad ki khiew umphniang baroh kat kiba dei kam bad ka.
Kin buh ïa ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh ha ka jyntap kaba da ka snieh blang bad nangta kin buh ïa ka sa ha ka krong.
Halor ka duwan ksiar kin phriang kawei ka jaiñ ka bajngum, kin tap ïa ka da ka jyntap kaba da ka snieh blang, nangta kin phrung ïa ki dieng ban bah ïa ka.

Kin shim ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba pyndonkam ha ki jinglehniam ha ka jaka kyntang, bad kin buh ïa ki ha kawei ka jaiñ ka bajngum, nangta kin tap ïa ki da ka jyntap kaba da ka snieh blang, bad kin buh ïa ki ha ka krong.
Kin khat noh ïa ka dpei na ka duwan, bad kin phriang kawei ka jaiñ sawsyngiang halor jong ka.

Halor jong kata kin tynrong ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh jong ka duwan, ba ju pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jinglehniam hangta, ïa ki pliang ding, ki proh, ki siang, bad ki dabor, baroh ki tiar ki tar jong ka duwan; hadien kata kin phriang halor jong ka kawei ka jyntap kaba da ka snieh blang, bad kin phrung ïa ki dieng ban bah ïa ka.

“Haba u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la dep ban tap ïa ki tiar bakhuid bad ïa ki tiar pynriam baroh jong ka jaka kyntang, ynda kiba shong dara ki la mih, kin wan ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kohath ban rah ïa kine, khlem da ktah ïa ki, ïoh ki ïap. Kine ki long kiei kiei ki jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh kiba ki khun ki ksiew u Kohath ki dei ban bah.

“U Eleasar u khun jong u Aron lyngdoh u dei ban peit ïa ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai, ïa ka dhup iwbih ïa ka jingtyrwa jynbam kaba man ka sngi, bad ïa ka umphniang pynsleh; u dei ruh ban peit ïa ka tabernakyl baroh nadong shadong bad ïa kiei kiei baroh katba don ha ka, ïa ka jaka kyntang bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka.”
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses, bad u Aron,
“Wat shah ba ki ïingkur jong ki Kohath kin duh jait napdeng ki Lebi.

Hynrei phi dei ban leh kumne ba kin dup im bad kin ym ïap haba ki wan shajan kiei kiei ki bakhuid tam: u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin leit rung bad kin aiti ha uwei pa uwei la kajong kajong ka kam, la kajong kajong ka jynkit.
Kim dei keiñ ban leit rung ban peit ïa kiei kiei ki bakhuid, wat shi khyllipmat, ïoh ki ïap.”
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses,
“To shim jingkheiñ ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Gershon ruh, shikur shikur, katkum la ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki;
ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh kiba sanphew snem ka ryta phi dei ban kheiñ kat kiba la tbit ban rung kam shakri, ban trei kam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
Kane ka long ka kam shakri jong ki ïingkur na ki khun ki ksiew u Gershon, haba ki trei bad ki bah.

Ki dei ban bah ïa ki pyrda jong ka tabernakyl, ïa ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ïa ka jynsop jong ka, ïa ka jyntap kaba da ka snieh blang kaba don halor jong ka, bad ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh,

ïa ki jynwah ka phyllaw, ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka khyrdop ba rung sha ka phyllaw, kaba don sawdong ka tabernakyl bad ka duwan, ïa ki tyllai jong ki, bad ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh kiba ïadei kam bad kine. Ki dei ban leh katba donkam ban leh shaphang kine kiei kiei.

“Baroh ka kam shakri jong ki khun ki ksiew u Gershon ka dei ban long hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, shaphang kiei kiei ba ki dei ban bah, shaphang kiei kiei ba dei ban pyndep. Phi dei ban aiti ha ki ïa kiei kiei baroh ba ki dei ban bah.
Kane kata ka kam shakri jong ki ïingkur kiba na ki khun ki ksiew u Gershon ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ka jyntrei jong ki ka hap hapoh ka jingpeit jong u Ithamar; u khun jong u Aron lyngdoh.
“Shaphang ki khun ki ksiew u Merari, phi dei ban shim jingkheiñ ïa ki shikur shikur, katkum ki ïing ki kpa tymmen jong ki.
Phi dei ban kheiñ ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh kiba sanphew snem ka ryta kat kiba lah ban rung kam shakri, kiba tbit ban trei kam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.

Kane ka long kata ka kam ban bah kaba hap ha ki, kum ka kam shakri jong ki baroh ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh: ki jynker jong ka tabernakyl, lem bad ki dieng khap, ki rijied, bad ki thliew shanam jong ka,

ki rijied jong ka phyllaw baroh sawdong lem bad ki thliew shanam ki prek, ki tyllai jong ki, bad ki tiar ki tar baroh kiba ïadei kam bad ki. Phi dei ban ai kam da ka kyrteng ïa ki tiar ba ki dei ban kit ban bah.
Kane ka kam shakri jong ki ïingkur na ki khun ki ksiew u Merari, baroh ka kam shakri jong ki tang ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh, hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Ithamar, u khun u Aron lyngdoh.”
Te u Moses bad u Aron lem bad ki ’riew rangbah jong u paidbah ki la shim jingkheiñ ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kohath, shikur shikur kat kum ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki,
ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh sanphew snem ka ryta, ïa man la u briew uba la bit ban rung kam shakri, ban trei ban ktah ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
U paid jong ki shikur shikur u la long arhajar hynñiewspah sanphew ngut.

Kane ka la long ka jingkheiñ ïa ki ïingkur jong ki khun ki ksiew u Kohath, kat kiba la shakri ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aron ki la kheiñ katkum ka hukum jong u Trai ha u Moses.
Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Gershon, shikur shikur katkum ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki,
ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh kiba sanphew snem ka ryta, man la u briew uba la bit ban rung kam shakri ban trei ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh;
ka jingkheiñ ïa ki shikur shikur katkum ka ïing kpa tymmen ka la long arhajar hynriewspah laiphew ngut.
Kane ka long ka jingkheiñ ïa ki ïingkur jong ki khun ki ksiew u Gershon, baroh lin kiba la shakri ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aron ki la kheiñ katkum ka hukum u Trai.
Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki ïingkur jong ki khun ki ksiew u Merari, shikur shikur katkum ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki,
ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh kiba sanphew snem ka ryta man la u briew uba la bit ban rung kam shakri, ban trei kam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh,
ka jingkheiñ ïa ki shikur shikur ka la long laihajar arspah ngut.
Kine ki long kito ïa kiba la kheiñ shikur shikur na ki khun ki ksiew u Merari, ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aron ki la kheiñ katkum ka hukum jong u Trai ha u Moses.
Baroh phar ki Lebi, ïa kiba u Moses, u Aron bad ki rangbah Israel ki la shim jingkheiñ katkum ki ïingkur bad ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki,
ïa kiba naduh laiphew snem ka ryta haduh kiba sanphew snem ka ryta, man la u briew uba la bit ban bah haba trei kam shakri ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh,
kito ïa kiba la kheiñ ki la long phrahajar sanspah phraphew ngut.
Katkum ka hukum u Trai ha u Moses ïa kine la thung, uwei pa uwei ha la ka kam ban shakri ne ban bah; ïa ki la kheiñ da u Moses kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ïa u.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To ai hukum ha ki paidbah Israel ba ki dei ban beh noh ïa u kynja bapang ’ñiangthohlieh, ïa u kynja ba don jingliat jakhlia, bad ïa u kynja bymkhuid ba u ïapyndei bad u baïap.
Phi dei ban beh noh ïa u shynrang ne ïa ka kynthei, da kaba pynmih ïa ki shabar ka jaka dara, khnang ba kin ym pynbyrsieh ïa ka jaka dara jong ki, ha kaba Nga shong.”
Ki paid Israel ki la leh ruh kumta, bad ki la beh noh ïa ki shabar ka jaka dara. Kumba u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, ki paid Israel ruh ki la leh kumta.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To ong ha ki paid Israel, haba u shynrang ne ka kynthei ki leh kano kano ka pap ba ki briew ki ju brai bad u pynkheiñ juban bad u Trai, uta u briew u kit pap.

Kumta u dei ban phla ïa la ka pap ba u la leh; u dei ban buria na ka bynta ka kam palat jong u, da kaba aitam sa shibynta na ka san bynta, bad u dei ban ai ïa ka ha uta u briew ïa uba u la leh kam bymdei.

Lada uta u briew um don kur don jait ha uba u dei ban buria na ka bynta ka jingleh palat, ka jingburia namar ka kam palat kan leit ha u Trai na ka bynta u lyngdoh, nalor u blang ka jingpynbiang, da uba yn sa pyndep ïa ka riti jingpynïasuk na ka bynta jong u.
Man la ka jyntyrwa, baroh kiei kiei ki bakhuid jong u paid Israel, kat kiba ki wan rah ha u lyngdoh, ki dei ban long ki jong u.
Ki kynja bakhuid jong u briew baroh ki dei ban long ki jong u; kat kaba uno uno u briew u ai ha u lyngdoh ka dei ka jong u.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To ong ha ki paid Israel, lada ka tnga uno uno u briew ka ïaid pathar bad ka leh haram ïa u,
lada u briew u ïaklim bad ka, khlem da tip u tnga jong ka, lada ka la pynbyrsieh ïa lade khlem don ba lap, bad ym don sakhi satar pyrshah ïa ka, namar ym shym ïoh kem ïa ka haba ka leh;

te lada ka wan ka mynsiem suba sniew ha u, bad u suba ïa la ka tnga kaba la pynjah burom shisha ïa lade; ne lada ka wan ka mynsiem bishni ha u, bad u suba sniew ïa la ka tnga, wat la kam shym la pynbyrsieh ïa lade;

uta u briew un wan ïalam ïa la ka tnga sha u lyngdoh, bad un wanlam ka jyntyrwa na ka bynta jong ka shibynta na ka shiphew bynta ka shi epha u purew barli. Um dei ban theh umphniang halor jong u bad um dei ban buh dhup iwbih halor jong u, namar ka long ka jyntyrwa jynbam na ka bynta ka jingsuba sniew, ka jyntyrwa jynbam pynkynduh jingmut ïa ka kam bymman.
“U lyngdoh un wanlam ïa ka shakhmat, bad un pynïeng ïa ka hakhmat u Trai.
Nangta u lyngdoh un shim ka um bakhuid ha u khiew khyndew, un shim sa u khyndew khyndiat na tbian jong ka tabernakyl bad un buh ïa u ha kata ka um.

U lyngdoh un pynïeng ïa kata ka kynthei hakhmat u Trai, un law ïa u ’ñiehkhlieh jong ka, bad un buh ha ki kti jong ka ïa ka jyntyrwa jynbam ban pynkynduh jingmut ïa ka, kaba long ruh ka jyntyrwa jynbam jong ka jingsuba sniew. Ha ka kti jong u pat, u lyngdoh un bat ïa ka um bakthang kaba wanlam ka jingtim.

Ynda nangta u lyngdoh un phah smai ïa ka, un ong, ‘Lada uno uno u briew um shym klim bad pha, bad lada pham shym la leh pathar ban pynjakhlia ïa lade, haba pha dang dei hapoh ka jingsynshar u tnga jong pha, to phan lait na ka jingtim jong kane ka um bakthang.
Hynrei lada pha la ïaid pathar, katba pha dang dei hapoh ka jingsynshar u tnga jong pha bad lada pha la pynbyrsieh ïa lade, bad pha la klim bad uei re uei u briew

te (ai u lyngdoh un phah ïa ka ban smai ïa ka jingtim, bad un ong ha ka kynthei) ‘to u Trai Un pynlong ïa pha ka nuksa jong ka jingtim bad ka jingsmai hapdeng ki parajait jong pha da kaba pynstait ïa ka lbong jong pha bad da kaba pynsieb ïa ka met jong pha.
To kane ka um kaba wanlam jingtim kan rung hapoh ki snier jong pha kan pynsieb ïa ka met jong pha bad kan pynstait ïa ka lbong jong pha’. Kata ka kynthei ka dei ban jubab, ‘Amen, Amen.’
“U lyngdoh nangta un thoh ïa kine ki jingtim ha ka kitab, bad un sait pyndam ïa ki ha ka um bakthang,
nangta un pyndih ha kata ka kynthei ïa ka um jong ka jingkthang kaba wanlam ka jingtim. Ka um jong ka jingtim kan rung hapoh jong ka bad kan pynpang ïa ka da ka jingkthang.
U lyngdoh un shim ïa ka jyntyrwa jynbam jong ka jingsuba sniew na ka kti jong ka kynthei, nangta un rah ïa ka jyntyrwa jynbam hakhmat u Trai bad un wan rah ïa ka sha ka duwan.
Hadien kata u lyngdoh un shim shi kham ka jyntyrwa jynbam, kum ka bynta jingkynmaw ïa ka, un thang ïa ka halor ka duwan, bad nangta pat un pyndih ïa ka kynthei da kata ka um.

“Te ynda u la pyndih ïa kata ka um ha ka kynthei, lada ka la pynbyrsieh ïa lade bad ka la leh be-ijot ïa la u tnga, kata ka um kaba wanlam ka jingtim kan rung hapoh jong ka bad kan pynpang ïa ka da ka jingkthang. Ka met jong ka kan sieb, ka lbong jong ka kan stait, bad ka kynthei kan sa long ka jingtim hapdeng ki para jait jong ka.
Hynrei lada ka kynthei kam shym la pynjah burom ïa lade bad ka long ka bakhuid, kan lait suk bad kan ïoh khun ïoh kti.
“Kane ka long ka riti ha ki kam suba sniew haba ka tnga, kaba don hapoh ka jingsynshar u tnga, ka ïaid pathar bad ka pynjah burom ïa lade,
lane haba u rangbah u don ka mynsiem suba sniew bad u suba ïa la ka tnga; hangta un leit ïalam ïa ka kynthei hakhmat u Trai, bad u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa kane ka riti ha ka nadong shadong.
U rangbah un laitkhuid na ka pop ka sang, hynrei ka kynthei kan kit ïa la ka jingbymman.”
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses,
“To ong ha ki paid Israel, lada u shynrang ne ka kynthei ki pynlong ka jingkular niam ka bakyrpang, ka jingkular niam ban long Nasir, ban aiti ïa lade ha u Trai,

uba kum uta u dei ban kyndiah na ka waiñ bad ka jingdih ka bakhor; um dei ban dih kano kno ka sirka ba shna na ka waiñ ne na ka jingdih ka bakhor; um dei ban dih kano kano ka umsoh kriep ne ban bam soh kriep kiba dang im ne kiba la thad.
Katba u long Nasir um dei ban bam kaei kaei kaba la shna na u diengsoh waiñ, wat ïa ki symbai ne ki snep.

“Baroh ki sngi ba u teh ïa lade da ka jingkular niam Nasir, um bit ban pyndei syrti ïa la ka khlieh; katba ym pat kut ka por kaba u la pynkyrpang ïa lade ha u Trai, u dei ban long u bakhuid; u dei ban ieh noh jrong ïa u shñiuh ka khlieh jong u.
“Ha ki sngi baroh ba u la pynkyntang ïa lade ha u Trai, um dei ban leit hajan ka met ïap.
Wat na ka bynta u kpa jong u, ne ka kmie jong u, ne u hynmen ne ka para jong u, lada ki ïap, um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade; naba ka jingpynkyrpang jong u ha u Blei ka don halor ka khlieh jong u.
Baroh shilynter ki sngi jong ka jingpynkyrpang jong u u long u bakhuid ha u Trai.

“Lada uno uno u briew u ïap kyndit kyndit hajan jong u, bad lada u pyntngit ïa la ka khlieh ba la pynkyntang, u dei ban khi noh ïa la ka khlieh ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynkhuid jong u; ha ka sngi ka bahynñiew u dei ban khi ïa ka.
Ha ka sngi ka baphra un wan rah ar tylli ki lyngdkhur ne ki khun paro ha u lyngdoh ha ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh,

u lyngdoh pat un tyrwa ïa kawei kum ka jyntyrwa na ka bynta ka pop, ïa kawei pat kum ka jyntyrwa thang, nangta un pyndep ïa ka riti jingpynïasuk namar jong u, namar u la pynbit pop ïa lade na ka met ïap. Un pynkyntang biang ïa la ka khlieh ha kata kajuh ka sngi;

un pynkyrpang biang ïa lade ha u Trai kum u Nasir; bad u dei ban wan rah uwei u ’langbrot uba la shi snem ka ryta kum u jynkñia jingpynbiang. Ïa ka por kaba la dep ym kheiñ shuh, namarba la pynbyrsieh ïa ka jingpynkyrpang jong u.
“Kane ka long ka riti ba u Nasir un leh haba ka por jingpynkyrpang jong u ka la dep. Dei ban ïalam ïa u sha ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh

bad u dei ban tyrwa ka jynai ha u Trai da uwei u ’langbrot shynrang u batlem uba dang shi snem ka ryta, kum u jynkñia thang; kawei ka ’langbrot kynthei ka batlem kaba dang shi snem ka ryta kum u jynkñia sait pop; bad uwei u blang u batlem kum u jynkñia ïabha ïamiat,

nangta shi shang u kpu khlem thiat, ki kpu kiba da u moida u bani ba la khleh bad ka umphniang bad ki ’pulyngkniap bakhlem thiat ba la kyllan umphniang, ryngkat bad ki jyntyrwa jynbam bad jyndih kiba ïahap bad ki.
Te u lyngdoh un wan rah ïa ki hakhmat u Trai bad un tyrwa ïa u jynkñia sait pop jong u, bad ïa u jynkñia thang.
Un tyrwa ïa u blang kum u jynkñia ïabha ïamiat ha u Trai, lem bad u kpu bakhlem thiat uba ha ka shang; u lyngdoh un tyrwa ruh ïa ki jyntyrwa jynbam bad jyndih ban pynbud ïa ka.

Ha ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh u Nasir un khi ïa la ka khlieh ba la pynkyntang, bad ynda u la shim ïa u shñiuh na ka khlieh ba la pynkyntang jong u, un buh ïa u ha ka ding kaba don hapoh u jynkñia ïabha ïamiat.

U lyngdoh pat nangta un shim ïa ka tyrpeng jong u blang ynda la dep shet ïa ka, lem bad uwei u kpu bakhlem thiat bad uwei u ’pu-lyngkniap bakhlem thiat. Un buh ïa kine ha ki kti jong u Nasir, hadien ba u la khi-noh ïa u shñiuh ba la pynkyntang jong u.

Nangta u lyngdoh un rah shajrong ïa ki na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa hakhmat u Trai. Ki long ka bynta ka bakhuid; ki long ki jong u lyngdoh, lem bad ka shadem ba la rah shajrong bad ka lbong ba la tyrwa. Hadien kata u Nasir u lah ban dih waiñ.

“Kane ka long ka riti ïa u Nasir uba shim ïa ka jingkular niam. Kane ka long ka jyntyrwa jong u ha u Trai haba u shim ïa ka jingkular niam jong u kum u Nasir, nalor kawei pat kaei kaei katba u kot bor. Un pyndep ïa ka jingkular niam ba u shim kumba buh ka riti ka jingpynkyrpang jong u kum u Nasir.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To kren ha u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u: Ha kane ka rukom phin kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel. Phin ong ha ki,
“To u Trai Un kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa phi bad Un sumar sukher ïa phi!
To u Trai Un peit sbun ïa phi, bad Un leh isynei ïa phi!
To u Trai Un peit ieid ïa phi, bad Un ai ïa phi ka jingmanbha manmiat!
“Ha kane ka rukom kin kyrpad ïa ka kyrteng jong Nga halor ki paid Israel, bad Nga Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki.”

Ha kata ka sngi haba u Moses u la dep ban pynïeng ïa ka tabernakyl, u la pynsleh bad u la pynkyntang ïa ka lem bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka. Ynda u la pynsleh bad u la pynkyntang ïa ka duwan bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka baroh,
ki rangbah kur jong ka Israel, ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki, ki khlieh duh jong ki jait bad kiba dei ban pynïaid ïa ka jingkheiñ briew ïa ki,

ki la tyrwa bad ki la wan rah hakhmat u Trai hynriew tylli ki kali ba la tap nalor, bad khat-ar tylli ki masi dab, kawei ka kali na ka bynta ar arngut ki rangbah kur, bad uwei u masi dab na ka bynta uwei uwei na ki. Ki la wan tyrwa ïa kine hakhmat ka tabernakyl.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To pdiang ïa kine na ki, ba yn ïoh pyndonkam ïa ki ha ka jingleh niam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad to ai ïa ki ha ki Lebi, ha uwei uwei katkum ka jingleh niam jong u.”
Kumta u Moses u la shim ïa kita ki kali bad ïa ki masi dab bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki Lebi.
U la ai ar tylli ki kali bad saw tylli ki masi dab ha ki khun shynrang u Gershon, katkum ka jingleh niam jong ki;
saw tylli ki kali bad phra tylli ki masi dab u la ai ha ki khun shynrang u Merari, katkum ka jingleh niam jong ki, hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Ithamar, u khun u Aron lyngdoh.
Hynrei ïa ki khun shynrang u Kohath um shym ai ei ei, namarba la aiti ha ki ban sumar tang ïa kiei kiei ki bakhuid ïa kiba dei tang ban shu bah ha ka tyrpeng.
Te ki rangbah kur ki la wan rah ki jyntyrwa na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka duwan ha ka sngi ba la pynsleh ïa ka, bad kita ki rangbah kur ki la tyrwa ïa la ki jynai hakhmat ka duwan.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, “To kin wan rah ïa la ki jyntyrwa, uwei u rangbah kur ha la ka jong ka sngi, na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka duwan.”
Uba la wan rah ïa la ka jyntyrwa ha ka sngi banyngkong u la long u Nahshon u khun u Amminadab, na ka jait Juda.

Ka jyntyrwa jong u ka la long kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang; baroh ar tylli ki dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
nangta kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, ka badap da ka dhup;
nangta uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa thang;
uwei u blang shynrang ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jingkñia jingsuk, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki ’langshynrang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane ka la long ka jyntyrwa u Nahshon u khun u Amminadab.
Ha ka sngi ka ba-ar, u Nethanel, u khun u Zuwar, u rangbah kur jong ki Issakhar, u la wan rah ka jyntyrwa.

U la tyrwa jynai, kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang; baroh ar tylli ki dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
nangta kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa thang;
uwei u blang ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki ’langshynrang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Nethanel, u khun u Zuwar.
Ha ka sngi ka balai, u Eliab u khun u Helon, u rangbah kur jong ki paid Zebulun,

u la tyrwa kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang; baroh ar tylli ki dap da u moida bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
nangta kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta na ka bynta ka jynkñia thang;
uwei u ’langshynrang ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki ’langshynrang bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Eliab, u khun u Helon.
Ha ka sngi ka basaw, u Elisur u khun u Shedeur, u rangbah kur jong ki jait Reuben, u la wan rah

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli ki dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang kum ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel kaba dap da ka dhup;

Ha ka sngi basan, u Shelumiel u khun u Zurishaddai, u rangbah kur ki jait Simeon, u la wan rah

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa jynbam;

uwei u blang ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki ’langshynrang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Shelumiel, u khun u Zurishaddai.
Ha ka sngi ka bahynriew, u Eliasaph, u khun u Dewel, u rangbah kur jong ki jait Gad, u la wan rah

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta kum ka jyntyrwa thang;
uwei u blang ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad kum ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki ’langshynrang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Eliasaph, u khun u Dewel.
Ha ka sngi ka bahynñiew, u Elishama u khun u Ammihud, u rangbah kur ki jait Ephraim, u la wan tyrwa

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang kum ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta, kum ka jynkñia thang;
uwei u blang ban kñia sait pop;

bad kum ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki blang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Elishama, u khun u Ammihud.
Ha ka sngi ka baphra, u Gamaliel, u khun u Pedasur u rangbah kur jong ki jait Manasse, u la wan tyrwa

kawei ka pliang rupa, kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai bad ka umphniang kum ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel kaba dap da ka dhup;

uwei u blang, kum u jynkñia na ka bynta ka pop;

bad kum ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki blang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa u Gamaliel, u khun u Pedasur.
Ha ka sngi ka bakhyndai, u Abidan, u khun jong u Gideoni, u rangbah kur jong ki jait Benjamin, u la tyrwa

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai bad ka umphniang kum ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta kum u jynkñia thang;
uwei u blang ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki blang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Abidan, u khun jong u Gideoni.
Ha ka sngi ka bashiphew, u Ahieser, u khun jong u Ammishaddai, u rangbah kur jong ki jait Dan, u la tyrwa

kawei ka pliang rupa, kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang kum ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta kum ka jyntyrwa thang;
uwei u blang, ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki blang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Ahieser, u khun u Ammishaddai.
Ha ka sngi ka bakhatwei, u Pakiel u khun jong u Okhran, u rangbah kur jong ki jait Asher, u la tyrwa

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jynkñia jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot u ba dang shi snem ka ryta kum ka jyntyrwa thang;
uwei u blang, ban tyrwa na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, san tylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki blang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Pakiel, u khun u Okhran.
Ha ka sngi ka bakhat-ar, u Ahira, u khun jong u Enan, u rangbah kur jong ki jait Naphtali, u la tyrwa

kawei ka pliang rupa kaba khia shispah laiphew shekel, kawei ka dabor rupa kaba hynñiewphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, baroh ar tylli kiba dap da u moida u bani ba la milai lang bad ka umphniang kum ka jyntyrwa jynbam;
kawei ka jyndiang ksiar kaba shiphew shekel, kaba dap da ka dhup;
uwei u masi lyngraw, uwei u ’langbrot, uwei u khun ’langbrot uba dang shi snem ka ryta kum ka jyntyrwa thang;
uwei u blang, kum u jynkñia na ka bynta ka pop;

bad na ka bynta ka jynkñia ïabha ïamiat, ar tylli ki masi dab, santylli ki ’langbrot, san tylli ki blang, bad san tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba dang shi snem ka ryta. Kane kata ka jyntyrwa jong u Ahira, u khun u Enan.

Kane kata ka jyntyrwa haba pynkyntang ïa ka duwan, ha kata hi ka sngi haba la pynsleh ïa ka, na ki rangbah kur jong ka Israel: khat-ar tylli ki pliang rupa, khat-ar tylli ki dabor rupa, khat-ar tylli ki jyndiang ksiar,

kawei kawei ka pliang rupa ka khia shispah laiphew shekel, bad kawei kawei ka dabor hynñiew shekel, ka rupa jong ki khiew ki pliang baroh ar hajar sawspah shekel, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang.

Nangta khat-ar tylli ki jyndiang ksiar, kiba dap da ka dhup, kiba khia shiphew shekel kawei kawei, katkum ka jingthew shekel jong ka jaka kyntang; ka ksiar jong ki jyndiang baroh ka la long shispah arphew shekel.

Ki jynri baroh na ka bynta ka jynkñia thang ki long khat-ar tylli ki masi kyrtong, khat-ar tylli ki ’langbrot, khat-ar tylli ki khun ’langbrot shynrang kiba shi snem ka ryta lem bad ki jyntyrwa jynbam kiba dei ïa ki; nangta sa khat-ar tylli ki blang, ban tyrwa sait pop.

Ki jingri baroh kiba dei na ka bynta ka jyntyrwa ïabha ïamiat, ki long arphew saw tylli ki masi kyrtong, hynriewphew tylli ki blang, bad hynriewphew tylli ki khun ’langbrot kiba shi snem ka ryta. Kine ki la long ki jyntyrwa na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka duwan, ynda la dep pynsleh ïa ka.

Te haba u Moses u la leit rung hapoh ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ban ïakren bad u Trai, u la ïohsngew ïa ka Sur kaba kren ha u nalor ka khet jingisynei kaba don halor ka synduk jong ka Sakhi napdeng ki ar tylli ki kherubim. Te ka Sur ka la kren ha u.
Te kumta u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To ong ha u Aron, haba phi pynïeng ïa ki sharak, ki hynñiew tylli ki sharak ki dei, ban shat jingshai hakhmat ka jynpynïeng sharak”.
U Aron te u la leh kumta; u la pynïeng ïa ki sharak ban pynshai hakhmat ka jynpynïeng sharak, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.

Ka rukom thang ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak ka la long da ka ksiar kaba shu shoh; naduh kjat haduh ki shrong syntiew jong ka, ka long ka jynthaw kaba shu shoh; katkum ka dur kaba u Trai U la pyni ha u Moses, une ruh u la thaw kumta ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To shim ïa ki Lebi napdeng ki paid Israel, bad to pynkhuid ïa ki.
Haba pynkhuid ïa ki phi dei ban leh kumne: synreit ïa ki da ka um jingpynkhuid, nangta ai kin khi baroh shi rynïeng, kin sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad kin pynkhuid ïa lade.

Nangta ai kin shim uwei u masi lyngraw bad ka jyntyrwa jynbam kaba ïadei bad u, kaba da u moida u bani ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang; ma phi pat phin shim uwei pat u masi lyngraw ban tyrwa sait pop.
Nangta wan ïalam ïa ki Lebi hakhmat ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad lum lang ïa u paid Israel baroh shi tyllup.
Haba phi wan ïalam ïa ki Lebi hakhmat u Trai, ki paid Israel kin buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki;
u Aron pat un tyrwa ïa ki Lebi hakhmat u Trai kum ka jyntyrwa ba ai kyrpang ki paid Israel. Kumta yn pynkyntang ïa ki ha ka kam jong u Trai.

Nangta ki Lebi kin buh ïa la ki kti halor ki khlieh jong ki masi kyrtong; phi pat phin tyrwa ïa uwei kum u jynkñia sait pop, ïa uwei pat kum u jynkñia thang ha u Trai, ban pyndep ïa ka riti jingpynïasuk na ka bynta ki Lebi.
Hadien kata phin ïalam ïa ki Lebi hakhmat u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, bad phin tyrwa ïa ki kum ka jynai ka bakyrpang ha u Trai.
“Ha kane ka rukom phin pynkyrpang ïa ki Lebi napdeng ki paid Israel, bad ki Lebi kin long ki jong Nga.
Hadien kata ki Lebi kin leit rung ban lehniam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ynda phi la pynkhuid ïa ki bad phi la tyrwa ïa ki kum ka jynai ka bakyrpang.
Namarba la aiti lut ïa ki ha Nga napdeng ki paid Israel. Nga la shim bujli da ki na ka bynta ïa lade, ha ka jaka jong kito ki khun phrangsngi baroh jong ki paid Israel.

Shisha baroh ki khun phrangsngi napdeng ki paid Israel ki long ki jong Nga, lada dei ki jong u briew ne ki jong u mrad. Na kato ka sngi ba Nga la pynïap ïa ki khun phrangsngi baroh jong ka ri Ijipt Nga la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ïa lade,
hynrei Nga la shim bujli da ki Lebi ha ka jaka jong ki khun phrangsngi baroh kiba napdeng ki paid Israel.

Nga la ai ïa ki Lebi kum ka jingai sngewbha ha u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u napdeng ki paid Israel, ba kin leh niam na ka bynta u paid Israel ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ban pyndep ïa ka riti jingpynïasuk na ka bynta ki paid Israel, ba yn ym don jingïap kyrthep hakhmat ki paid Israel lada ki paid Israel ki wan shajan ka jaka kyntang.”
U Moses, u Aron bad ki paid Israel baroh shi tyllup ki la leh kumne ha ki Lebi; kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses shaphang ki Lebi, thik kumta ki paid Israel ki la leh ïa ki.

Te ki Lebi ki la pynkhuid ïa lade na ka pop bad ki la sait ïa la ki jaiñ; u Aron pat u la tyrwa ïa ki kum ka jynai bakyrpang hakhmat u Trai, bad u Aron u la pyndep ïa ka riti jingpynïasuk na ka bynta jong ki ban pynkhuid ïa ki.

Te hadien kata ki Lebi ki la leit rung ban lehniam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh hakhmat u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u. Kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses shaphang ki Lebi, kumta thik ki la leh ïa ki.
“Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“Kane ka dei ïa ki Lebi: Naduh kiba arphew san snem ka ryta bad shaneng ki dei ban pyndep ïa ka kam jinglehniam ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
Ynda ki la dap sanphew snem ka ryta ki dei ban ieh noh noh ïa ka kam jinglehniam bad kim dei shuh ban lehniam.
Hynrei kin ïarap lem ïa ki hynmen para ha kaban pyndep ïa ki kamram lehniam, bad ma ki kim dei ban lehniam ei ei shuh. Da kumne phin pynbeit ïa ki Lebi haba ai kam ïa ki.”
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses ha ri kynjah Sinai, ha u bnai u banyngkong jong ka snem ka ba-ar hadien ba ki la mih na ri Ijipt. U la ong,
“To ki paid Israel kin rakhe ïa ka Paskha ha ka por ba la buh-ïá ïa ka.
Ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw jong une u bnai, ynda sepsngi phi dei ban rakhe ïa ka ha ka por ba la buh-ïá ïa ka. Phi dei ban rakhe ïa ka katkum ki aiñ bad ki riti niam jong ka baroh.”
Kumta u Moses u la ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka Paskha.
Te ki la rakhe ïa ka Paskha ha u bnai u banyngkong, ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw jong uta u bnai, ynda sepsngi ha ri kynjah Sinai. Kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses, ki paid Israel ki la leh ruh kumta.

Te la don katto katne ki briew ki bymkhuid namarba ki la ktah ïa ka met ïap jong u briew, kumta kim shym lah ban rakhe ïa ka Paskha ha kata ka sngi. Te kita ki briew ki la wan hakhmat u Moses bad u Aron ha kata ka sngi,

ki la ong ha u, “Ngi long ki bymkhuid namarba ngi la ktah ïa ka met ïap jong u briew; balei keiñ yn khang ïa ngi ban wan rah ka jyntyrwa ha u Trai ha ka por ba la buh-ïá ïa ka, lem bad kiwei pat ki paid Israel?”
Te u Moses u la ong ha ki, “Ap, haduh ba ngan da ïohsngew aïu u Trai U hukum shaphang jong phi.”
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses,

“To ong ha ki paid Israel, lada uno uno na phi ne na ki khun ki kti jong phi u long u bymkhuid namarba u la ktah ïa ka met ïap, ne ba u la leit lynti jngai, u dang dei ban rakhe ïa ka Paskha ban burom ïa u Trai.
Ha u bnai u ba-ar ha ka sngi ka bakhatsaw ynda sepsngi ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka. Ki dei ban bam ïa u ’langbrot bad u kpu bakhlem thiat bad ki jhur kthang.
Kim dei ban pynsah ei ei na kata haduh mynstep, ne ban pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka shyieng jong u. Ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka riti Paskha baroh.

Lada u briew u bakhuid bad u bymleit jingleit um treh ban rakhe ïa ka Paskha, ïa uta u briew dei ban tait noh na ki para briew jong u, namarba um shym wan rah jyntyrwa ha u Trai ha ka por ba la buh-ïá; uta u briew u dei ban kit ïa la ka pop.

Lada u nongwei nongar u shongbasa bad phi bad u rakhe ïa ka Paskha ban burom ïa u Trai, u dei ban leh katkum ka aiñ jong ka Paskha bad katkum ka riti niam jong ka. Phi dei ban don tang kawei ka aiñ na ka bynta u nongshong basa bad u trai shnong.”
Ha kata ka sngi ba la pynïeng ïa ka tabernakyl, u lyoh u la tap ïa ka tabernakyl, ïa ka ïing jaiñ jong ka Sakhi bad ynda sepsngi u la tap khlup ïa ka tabernakyl ha ka dur jong ka ding haduh mynstep.
Kumta u la don barabor; u lyoh u la tap ïa ka mynsngi, mynmiet pat ha ka dur jong ka ding.
Kat haba u lyoh u kiew shajrong ka ïing jaiñ, ki paidbah Israel ki mih ban ïaid; ha kata ka jaka pat ba u lyoh u sangeh, hangta hi ki paid Israel ki shong dara.
Tang shu hukum u Trai, ki paid Israel ki mih, bad tang shu hukum, ki shong dara; katba u lyoh u dang neh halor ka tabernakyl, ki ruh ki sah ha ka jaka dara.
Wat haba u lyoh u neh bun sngi halor ka tabernakyl, ki paid Israel ki bat ïa ka hukum u Trai, bad kim mih.
Hateng hateng u lyoh u neh katto katne sngi halor ka tabernakyl, bad katkum ka hukum u Trai ki sah ha ka jaka dara. Tang ynda la ïoh hukum na u Trai ki sa mih.

Hateng hateng u lyoh u la neh tang naduh sepsngi haduh mynstep; bad haba ïa u lyoh la kyntiew shaneng ynda mynstep, ki la mih. Ne lada u neh shisngi shimiet, ki sa mih ynda la kyntiew shaneng ïa u lyoh.

Lada ka dei ar sngi, ne shibnai, ne kham slem, ba u lyoh u neh halor ka tabernakyl, katba u dang neh hangta, ki paid Israel ki la shong sah ha ka jaka dara bad kim mih; hynrei ynda la rah shaneng ïa u ki sa mih.
Tang haba hukum u Trai ki la shong dara; tang haba hukum u Trai ki la mih. Katba hukum u Trai da u Moses, ki la ïaineh skhem bad u Trai.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To thaw ar tylli ki turoi rupa; phi dei ban shu shoh haba thaw ïa ki. Phin pyndonkam ïa ki haba khot lang ïa u paidbah, bad haba phah mih na jaka dara.
Haba put ïa ki baroh ar tylli, baroh u paidbah un ïalum lang sawdong jong phi hakhmat ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
Hynrei lada ki put tang kawei, tang ki rangbah kur, ki khlieh duh jong ki jait Israel, kin ïalum lang sawdong jong phi.
Haba phi put ïa ka surmih ki jaka dara kiba shaphang mihngi kin mih.
Haba phi put sa shi wat ïa ka surmih ki jaka dara kiba shaphang shathie kin mih. Kat haba dei ban mih, dei ban put ïa ka turoi.
Hynrei haba dei ban lum lang ïa ka jingïalang, phi dei ban put, tangba phim dei ban put ïa ka surmih.
Dei ki khun shynrang u Aron, ki lyngdoh, kiba dei ban put ïa ki turoi. Ka jingput ïa ki turoi kan long ka aiñ kaba neh junom ha ki pateng jong phi baroh.

Haba phi leit thma ha ka ri jong phi pyrshah u nongshun uba bánbeiñ ïa phi, hangta phin put ïa ka turoi thma, khnang ba u Trai u Blei jong phi Un kynmaw ïa phi, bad Un pyllait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi.

Wat ha ka sngi jingkmen jong phi, ha ki jinglehniam ba la buh-ïá, bad haba mih ki bnai thymmai, phi dei ban put ïa ki turoi halor ki jynkñia thang jong phi, bad halor ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat jong phi. Kin long kum ka jingpynkynmaw ïa phi hakhmat u Blei jong phi: Nga Nga long u Trai u Blei jong phi”.
Ha ka snem ka ba-ar, ha ka sngi ka ba-arphew jong u bnai u ba-ar ïa u lyoh la rah noh shajrong naneng ka tabernakyl jong ka Sakhi,
bad ki paid Israel ki la mih ban ïaid shi jaka jaka na ri kynjah Sinai. Te u lyoh u la sangeh ha ri kynjah Paran.
Haba ki la mih nyngkong da ka hukum u Trai ba ai u Moses,
ka lama jong ka dara ki jait Juda ka la mih nyngkong, shi kynhun kynhun, bad halor jong ki paid thma jong ki la don u Nahshon, u khun u Amminadab.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Issakhar la don u Nethanel, u khun u Zuwar.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Zebulun la don u Eliab, u khun u Helon.
Haba la lied ïa ka tabernakyl, ki khun shynrang u Gershon bad ki khun shynrang u Merari, ki la bah ïa ka tabernakyl bad ki la mih.
Ka lama jong ka dara u Reuben ka la mih shi kynhun kynhun; bad halor ki paid thma jong ki la don u Elisur, u khun u Shedeur.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Simeon la don u Shelumiel, u khun u Zurishaddai.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Gad la don u Eliasaph, u khun u Dewel.
Nangta ki la mih ki thana u Kohath, kiba rah ïa kiei kiei ki bakhuid, bad ïa ka tabernakyl la pynïeng shuwa ba kin poi ma ki.
Ka lama jong ka dara ki jait Ephraim ka la mih shi kynhun kynhun, bad halor ki paid thma jong ki la don u Elishama, u khun u Ammihud.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Manasse pat la don u Gamaliel, u khun u Pedasur.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Benjamin la don u Abidan, u khun u Gideoni.
Te ka lama jong ka dara ki jait Dan, kaba wan hadien eh jong ki dara baroh, ka la mih shi kynhun kynhun; halor ki paid thma jong ki la don u Ahieser, u khun u Ammishaddai.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Asher la don u Pakiel, u khun u Okhran.
Halor ki paid thma jong ki jait Naphtali la don u Ahira, u khun u Enan.
Kane ka la long ka jingpynbeit haba ki paid Israel ki la ïaid katkum la ki jong ki jong ki paid thma. Kumta ki la mih.

U Moses te u la ong ha u Hobab, u khun jong u Rewel, u nong Midian, u kthaw kurim jong u Moses, “Ngi ïamih ban leit sha ka jaka kaba u Trai U la kular ban ai ïa ngi. Ïa bad ngi, bad ngin leh bha ïa phi, naba u Trai U la kular ka jingbha ïa ki Israel.”
Hynrei u la ong ha u, “Ngam treh ban leit; ngan leit noh sha la ka ri, sha la ki kur ki jait jong nga.”
Te u Moses u la phai ktien, “Wat ieh noh seh ïa ngi, nga kyrpad ïa phi, naba phi phi tip kumno ngi dei ban sher dara ha ri kynjah, bad phin long ki khmat jong ngi.
Lada phi wan lang bad ngi, kano kano ka jingbha ba u Trai Un ai ha ngi, ngin ai lem ha phi.
Kumta ki la mih na u lum jong u Trai lai sngi lynti. Ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai ka la nang ïaid ha shuwa jong ki lai sngi lynti de, ban wad ka jaka sangeh na ka bynta jong ki.
Te u lyoh jong u Trai u la don halor jong ki mynsngi, kat haba ki mih na ka jaka dara.
Kat haba ka synduk ka mih, u Moses u shait ong, “To ïeng, ko Trai, bad ai ba ki nongshun jong Me kin sapra; ai ba kito kiba isih ïa Me, kin her ïap nakhmat jong Me.”
Haba ka la shong pynjahthait, u la ong, “To wan phai, ko Trai, sha ki paid byllien bah jong u Israel.”

Te ki paidbah ki la khñium, bad u Trai u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhñium jong ki. Haba u Trai U la ïohsngew ïa kata, U la khie bitar ir. Ka ding jong u Trai ka la klang hapdeng jong ki, bad ka la thang duh ïa kawei ka dong jong ka jaka dara.
Hangta ki paidbah ki la kyang sha u Moses, bad u Moses u la duwai ïa u Trai, ynda kumta ka ding ka sa lip.
Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot Tabera naba ka ding jong u Trai ka la klang hapdeng jong ki.
Te u paidbhur uba ïadon ryngkat bad ki u la long u bajlawnguid haduh katta katta, ba ki paid Israel ruh ki la ïa-ud biang, ki ong, “A ba ngin da ïoh doh ban bam!
Ngi sngewkynmaw ïa ki dohkha ba ngi ïoh bam ei ha Ijipt, ïa ki soh khia, ïa ki soh melon, ïa ki jyllang, ïa ki piat bad ïa ki rynsun.
Hynrei mynta la stait baroh ka bor ka sor jong ngi, bad ym don ei ei satia, hynrei tang une u manna ban peit.”
Te u manna u la long kum u symbai dhania, bad ka dur ka dar jong u kum u bdellium.

Ki paidbah ki la leit kylleng kylleng bad ki la khar ïa u; ki la tylliat ïa u ha ki maw tylliat ne ki shu dung ïa u ha ki thlong, nangta ki sa shet ïa u ha ki khiew, bad ki thaw kpu da u. U bang kumba bang ki kpu ba shet ha ka umphniang.
Haba hap umjer mynmiet ha ka jaka dara, u manna u hap lang bad ka.
U Moses u la ïohsngew ba ki paidbah ki ud ha la ïing la sem, man la u briew ha jynkhang ïing jaiñ lajong. Hangta ka jingbitar u Trai ka la klang lep, bad u Moses u la khuslai.
Te u Moses u la ong ha u Trai, “Balei Me pynjynjar ïa u shakri jong Me? Hato keiñ Mem peit isynei shuh ïa nga, ba Men pynkit halor jong nga ïa u paid bynriew uba kat une?

Hato dei ma nga mo uba la pun ïa une u paid bynriew? Hato nga la kha ma nga ïa ki, ba Men ong ha nga, ‘To rah ïa ki ha ka shadem jong phi, kumba rah ka aïa ïa i khunlung iba dang buiñ,’ shaduh kata ka ri kaba Me la smai ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki?
Nangno keiñ ngan ïoh doh ban ai kat une u paid bynriew? Naba ki ud hakhmat jong nga bad ki ong, ‘Ai doh ïa ngi ba ngin bam.’
Ngam lah ban kit marwei kat une u paid bynriew baroh, ka jingkit ka khia palat ïa nga.
Lada Me kwah ban leh da kumne ïa nga, shu pynïap noh ïa nga shisyndon lada Me sngewsynei ïa nga, ba ngan kut la ka jinglanot.”

Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, “Khie lum lang hakhmat jong Nga ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki tymmen ki san Israel, kiba phi tip ba ki dei ki ’riew-rangbah bad ki ’riewkitkam jong u paidbah. Ïalam ïa ki sha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad phah kin ïeng lang bad phi ha kata ka jaka.

Ngan wan hiar ban kren bad phi hangta; Ngan shim khyndiat na ka mynsiem kaba don ha phi bad Ngan buh ïa kata halor jong ki. Kumta kin ïakit lem ïa ka jingkit jong u paidbah bad phi, khnang ba phin ym kit tang ma phi marwei.

To ong ha ki paidbah, ‘To pynkhuid ïa lade na ka bynta lashai, bad phin sa ïoh bam doh; naba phi la ïam haduh ba da ïohsngew u Trai, bad phi ong, “Mano keiñ uban ai doh ïa ngi ban bam? A ha Ijipt ngi la suk la saiñ.” Te kumta u Trai Un sa ai doh ïa phi, bad phin sa bam.
Phin sa bam ym tang shi sngi, ne ar sngi, ne san sngi, ne shiphew sngi, ne arphew sngi,

hynrei shi bnai kynthih, haduh ba kan da mih naduh thliew khmut bad phin da ijli ïa ka, namarba phi la lyndet ïa u Trai Uba don hapdeng jong phi, bad phi la ud hakhmat jong u, “Balei ngi la mih noh na Ijipt?” ’ ”
Hangta u Moses u la ong, “U paid bynriew sawdong jong nga kiba ïaid kjat u long hynriew spah hajar ngut, bad Me ong, ‘Ngan ai doh ïa u ba un ïabam shi bnai kynthih!’
Hato yn shoh doh noh ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ïa ki kynhun jynri na ka bynta jong ki, ba kin dup dap? Ne hato yn lum lang ïa ki dohkha baroh jong ka duriaw, ban pyndap ïa ki?”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, “Hato ka ksangti jong u Trai ka lyngkot? Phin sa ïohi mynta lada ka ktien jong Nga kan urlong ne em.”

Kumta u Moses u la mih shabar bad u la ïathuh ha ki paidbah ïa ki ktien jong u Trai. U la lum lang ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki tymmen ki san jong u paidbah, bad u la phah ïeng ïa ki sawdong ka ïing jaiñ.

Te u Trai U la wan hiar ha u lyoh bad U la kren ha u. U la shim khyndiat na ka mynsiem kaba don ha u Moses bad U la bsiap ïa ka halor kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki tymmen ki san. Haba kata ka mynsiem ka la shong halor jong ki, ki la ïathuh lypa katto katne por.

Ka la jia ba ar ngut ki rangbah—uwei u kyrteng u Eldad bad uwei pat u Medad—kim shym leit sha ka ïing jaiñ, hynrei ki la sah ha ka jaka dara. Kine ruh ki dei napdeng kito ïa kiba la khot kyrpang. Te u mynsiem u la wan shong halor jong ki, kumta ki la ïathuh lypa ha ka jaka dara.
Uwei u samla u la mareh ban ïathuh ha u Moses, “U Eldad bad u Medad ki ïathuh lypa ha ka jaka dara.”
U Joshwa, u khun jong u Nun, u ’rangdajied bad u myntri u Moses, u la ong, “Ko Moses kynrad jong nga, to khang ïa ki.”
Hynrei u Moses u la ong ha u, “Hato phi bishni ïa u na ka bynta jong nga? Ban da ki briew baroh jong u Trai kin long ki nongïathuhlypa! Ban da u Trai un buh ïa la u Mynsiem halor jong ki!”
Te u Moses bad ki tymmen ki san jong ki Israel ki la wan phai sha ka jaka dara.

Te la wan ka lyer na u Trai, bad ka la wan kit ki ’iarkhiar na duriaw. Ka la pynhap ïa ki hajan kata ka jaka dara, kumba shi sngi lynti na kawei ka liang bad shi sngi lynti na kawei pat ka liang, baroh sawdong kata ka jaka dara, bad ki dap smam kumba ar pruh nalor ka khyndew.

U paidbah u la ïamih baroh shi sngi, baroh shi miet, bad sa shi sngi shuh kum lashai, bad ki la ïalum ïa kita ki ’iarkhiar. Uba khar duna eh u la lum shiphew homer; nangta ki la thad ïa ki baroh sawdong kata ka jaka dara.
Katba ka doh ka dang sah tymbeng hapdeng ki bniat jong ki, ym pat shym ktha ïa ka, ka jingbitar u Trai ka la khie ir pyrshah uta u paidbah. U Trai U la shoh ïa u paidbah da ka jingïapthem ka bajur.
Namarkata ïa ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka la khot Kibroth-hatta-aba, namar la tep hangta ïa kita ki briew kiba jlawnguid.
Na Kibroth-hatta-aba ki paidbah ki la leit shaduh Haseroth, bad ki la shong dara ha Haseroth.
Ka Miriam bad u Aron ki la kren khñium pyrshah u Moses namar ka kynthei Kushith ïa kaba u la shongkurim, naba u la shongkurim ïa ka kynthei Kushith.
Ki la ong, “Hato u Trai U la kren tang da u Moses mo? Hato Um shym la kren da ngi ruh?” Bad u Trai U la ïohsngew ïa kata.
Te u Moses u la long u briew u bajemnud shibun, kham palat ban ïa ki briew baroh kiba don ha sla khyndew.
Kyndit kyndit u Trai U la kren ha u Moses, ha u Aron bad ka Miriam, “Ale ma phi baroh lai ngut sha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh. Te ki la ïaleit baroh lai ngut.
U Trai U la wan hiar ha u rishot lyoh, bad U la ïeng ha ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ. U la khot ïa u Aron bad ka Miriam, bad ki la wan shakhmat baroh ar ngut.
Te U la ong, “To sngap ïa ki ktien jong Nga: Lada don hapdeng jong phi u nongïathuhlypa, Nga u Trai Nga pynpaw ïa lade ha u ha ka jingïohipaw, Ngan kren bad u ha ka jingphohsniew.
Ym dei kumta bad u shakri jong Nga u Moses; ha u la pynkhamti baroh ïa ka ïing ka sem jong Nga.
Bad u Nga kren markhmat, da kaba shai, ym da ki ktien kyllaiñ; u ïoh khmih artat ïa ka dur u Trai. Kumno keiñ phi la nud sat ban kren pyrshah ïa u shakri jong Nga u Moses?”
Te ka jingbitar u Trai ka la khie ir pyrshah ïa ki bad U la leit noh.
Tang shu kynriah u lyoh nalor ka ïing jaiñ, hakhmih, ka Miriam ka la sa-’ñiangthohlieh, ka la lieh kum ka ïor. U Aron u la phai ban peit ïa ka Miriam, hakhmih, ka la sa-’ñiangthohlieh.
Te u Aron u la ong ha u Moses, “A ko kynrad jong nga, wat pynshitom ïa ngi naba ngi la leh biej bad ngi la leh pop.
Wat ieh noh ïa ka kum ïa u khunlung ba la kha ïap, kum uba la bam pong shiteng ka met haba u mih na ka kpoh ka kmie jong u.”
Te u Moses u la lynñiar ha u Trai, “To pynkhiah ïa ka, A Blei, nga kyrpad ïa Me.”

Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, “Lada u kpa jong ka u la bynthiew ïa ka khmat jong ka, hato kan ym leh rain hynñiew sngi? Phah set ïa ka shabar ka jaka dara hynñiew sngi, bad sa pynrung biang ïa ka hadien kata.”
Kumta ïa ka Miriam la khang shabar ka jaka dara hynñiew sngi, bad u paidbah um shym mih ban ïaid lynti haduh ba yn da pynrung biang ïa ka Miraim.
Hadien kata ki paidbah ki la mih na Haseroth, bad ki la shong dara ha ri kynjah Paran.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To phah briew ban leit peit syntiat ïa ka ri Kanaan, kaba Ngan sa ai ha ki paid Israel. Phin phah uwei u briew na kawei kawei ka jait ki kpa tymmen jong ki. Phah ïa ki nongïalam ka jait.”
Kumta u Moses u la phah ïa ki na ri kynjah Paran, katkum ka hukum u Trai, baroh ki dei ki khlieh duh jong ki paid Israel.
Kine kita ki kyrteng jong ki: na ka jait u Reuben, u Shammua, u khun u Zakkur;
na ka jait u Simeon, u Shaphat, u khun u Hori;
na ka jait u Juda, u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne;
na ka jait u Issakhar, u Ikal, u khun u Joseph;
na ka jait u Ephraim, u Hoshea, u khun u Nun;
na ka jait u Benjamin, u Palti, u khun u Raphu;
na ka jait u Zebulun, u Gaddiel, u khun u Sodi;
na ka jait u Joseph (kata ka mut, na ka jait u Manasse), u Gaddi, u khun u Susi;
na ka jait u Dan, u Ammiel, u khun u Gemalli;
na ka jait u Asher, u Sethur, u khun u Mikhael;
na ka jait u Naphtali, u Nabi u khun u Bopsi;
na ka jait u Gad, u Gewel, u khun u Maki.
Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong kita ki rangbah ïa kiba u Moses u la phah ban peit syntiat ïa kata ka ri. Ïa u Hoshea, u khun jong u Nun, u Moses u la kyrteng Joshwa.
U Moses u la phah ïa ki ban peit syntiat ïa ka ri Kanaan, bad u la bthah ïa ki, “Khie leit shaduh sha palat Nekeb, bad leit kiew shaduh ri lum.
Peit kaba kumno ka ri ka long, lada ki briew kiba shong ha ka ki long ki bakhlaiñ ne ki batlot bor, lada ki ïadon khyndiat ne shibun,
lada ka ri ba ki shong ka long ka babha ne ka basniew, lada ki shnong jong ki ki long kiba shu shong madan ne kiba la tei kut,

lada ka ri ka long ka baseisoh ne ka balyngki, lada ka don ki khlaw ki btap ne ka shu madan lin. To long ki bashlur, bad sa wan rah katto katne u soh jong kata ka ri.” Kata ka por ka dei ka aïom ba la sdang ih ki soh kriep.
Kumta ki la leit kiew bad ki la peit syntiat ïa kata ka ri naduh ka ri kynjah Zin haduh Rehob, marsyndah ka lynti khim Hamath.
Ki la leit kiew shaduh Nekeb, nangta ki la poi ha Hebron; u Ahiman, u Sheshai bad u Talmai, ki khun ki ksiew u Anak ki la shong hangta. (Ïa ka Hebron la tei hynñiew snem shuwa ka Zoan ha Ijipt).

Ki la wan poi sha ka Them Eshkol, bad ki la pom nangta kawei ka tnat kaba don shi tyrjup ki soh kriep bad ar ngut na ki ki la shu bah da u dieng ïa ka; ki la wan rah ruh khyndiat ki soh pomkranet bad ki soh lapong.
Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Them Eshkol, na ka bynta kata ka tyrjup kaba ki rangbah Israel ki la pom nangta.
Ynda la kut sawphew sngi, ki la wan phai na ka jingleit syntiat ïa kata ka ri.

Ki la wan sha u Moses bad u Aron bad sha ki paidbah Israel baroh shi tyllup ha ri kynjah Paran, ha Kadesh. Ki la wan rah khubor sha ki bad sha u paid baroh shi tyllup bad ki la pyni ha ki ïa u soh jong kata ka ri.
Te ki la ïathuh ïa u Moses, “Ngi la poi sha ka ri ba phi la phah ïa ngi; ka tuid shisha da ka dud bad ka ngap, bad une u soh jong ka.
Hynrei ki briew kiba shong ha kata ka ri te ki long ki bakhlaiñ, ki shnong jong ki ruh kiba la ker kut bad kiba heh; nalor nangta, ngi la ïohi ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anak hangta.
Ki Amalek ki shong ha ka ri Nekeb; ki Hit, ki Jebus, bad ki Amor ki shong ha ri lum; ki Kanaan pat ki shong harud duriaw, bad ha markhap ka Jordan.”
U Kaleb u la pynsngap jar ïa ki paidbah kiba la don hakhmat u Moses, bad u la ong, “Ïa ngin ïaleit tur shi syndon, bad ngin ïadakhol ïa ka; naba ngi lah biang biang ban jop ïa ka.”
Pynban kita ki briew kiba la leit ryngkat bad u ki la ong, “Ngin ym lah ban ïaleh ïa kine ki briew, naba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ngi.”

Kumta ki la pynphriang ha ki paid Israel ka khubor ka basniew shaphang kata ka ri ba ki la leit peit syntiat, da kaba ong, “Kata ka ri kaba ngi la ïaid lyngba ban peit syntiat ka la long ka ri kaba bam duh ïa la ki trai shnong; ki briew baroh kat kiba ngi la ïohi ha ka ki la long ki bajrong mlen.
Ngi la ïohi hangta ïa ki Nephilim (Ki khun ki ksiew u Anak uba la hiar pateng na ki ’riewradbah.) Ngi la sngew ïa lade kum ki puit, bad ngi long ruh kumta ha ka jingñiew jong ki ïa ngi.”
Te u paidbah baroh u la lynñiar jam bad ki briew ki la ïaïam baroh shi miet.
Ki paid Israel ki la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aron; baroh shi paid ki la ïa-ong ha ki, “A ba ngin da la ïap ha ri Ijipt, ne la kumno kumno ha ri kynjah!
Balei keiñ u Trai U wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri ban ïap da ka waitlam, bad ki tnga jong ngi bad ki khun rit jong ngi ban shah rong ei? Hato ym kham bha ba ngin leit phai biang sha ri Ijipt?”
Kumta ki la ïa ong para ma ki, “Ïa ngin ïajied uwei u nongïalam, bad ngin ïaleit phai biang sha Ijipt.”
Te u Moses bad u Aron ki la dem pyllup hakhmat ka jingïalang baroh kawei jong u paid Israel.
U Joshwa u khun u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun u Jephunne, kiba la ïadon lang bad kito kiba la leit peit syntiat ïa kata ka ri, ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ,
bad ki la ong ha kata ka kynhun jong u paid Israel, “Kata ka ri, kaba ngi la ïaid lyngba ban peit syntiat ïa ka, ka long ka ri ka babha haduh katta katta.
Lada u Trai U sngewbha ïa ngi, Un ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri bad Un ai ïa ka ha ngi, ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap.

Hei, wat pyn-eh ïa u Trai; wat tieng ïa ki briew kata ka ri, naba ngin sa bam ïa ki. Ïa ka jingïada ba ki don la weng noh na ki, bad u Trai U don ryngkat bad ngi; wat sheptieng ïa ki.” Hynrei uta u paidbah baroh u la byrngem ban shu lynthem noh ïa ki da ki maw.
Markumta ka burom jong u Trai ka la paw ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ha kaba la don baroh ki paidbah Israel.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses, “Haduh katno une u paid un ibeiñ ïa Nga? Haduh lano kin ym ngeit ïa Nga, wat la Nga la leh ki dak phylla hapdeng jong ki?
Ngan shoh ïa ki da ka khlam bad Ngan kyntait artat ïa ki. Ïa phi pat Ngan pynlong ka jait bynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa ki.”
Hynrei u Moses u la phai ktien sha u Trai, “Te ki Ijipt kin sa ïohsngew ïa kane, naba ma Me Me la wan ïalam ïa une u paid napdeng jong ki da ka borbah jong Me,

bad kin sa ïathuh ïa ki trai shnong jong kane ka ri. Ki la ïohsngew ba ma Me, ko Trai, Me don hapdeng une u paid; ba ma Me, ko Trai, Me paw markhmat markhmat; ba u lyoh jong Me u ïeng halor jong ki, bad ba ma Me Me ïalam lynti ïa ki da u rishot lyoh mynsngi bad da u rishot ding mynmiet.
Te lada Me pynïap noh ïa une u paid la kum ïa uwei u briew, hangta ki jait bynriew kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka nam jong Me kin sa ïa-ong,
‘Namarba u Trai Um sngewlah ban ïalam ïa une u paid sha kata ka ri kaba U la kular ban ai ha ki, kumta U la shu pynïap noh ïa ki ha ri kynjah.’
Mynta nga kyrpad ïa Me, to ai ba ka bor jong u Trai kan long ka bakhraw kumba Me la kular, haba Me la ong,

‘U Trai U long u basuki ban bitar, u bakynrei ka jingieid, bad Uba map ïa ka jingbymman bad ka jingtamsneng, hynrei Ubym ju pyllait jem da lei lei ïa uba ieid pop, Uba pynkit ïa ka jingbymman ki kpa halor ki khun ki ksiew, haduh lai bad saw pateng bynriew.’
To map ïa ka jingbymman une u paid bynriew, nga kyrpad ïa Me, katkum ka jingieid jong Me ka bakhraw katta katta, kumba me la ju map ïa une hi u paid naduh Ijipt haduh mynta.”
Te u Trai U la jubab, “Nga la map kumba phi kyrpad.
Hynrei, da shisha shisha, kumba Nga im, bad kumba ka pyrthei baroh ka dei ban dap da ka burom jong u Trai,

napdeng kito ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa ka burom jong Nga bad ïa ki dak phylla ba Nga la leh ha Ijipt bad ha ri kynjah, hynrei kiba la haram pynban ïa Nga la jin shiphew wat, khlem da kheiñ snep satia ïa ka ktien jong Nga,
yn ym don uwei uban ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba Nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki. Napdeng kito kiba la ibeiñ ikhoh ïa Nga yn ym don wat uwei uban ïohi ïa ka.

Hynrei u shakri jong Nga u Kaleb, namarba u don ka mynsiem ka bapher bad u la kohnguh ïa Nga nadong shadong, Ngan sa ïalam ïa u sha kata ka ri kaba u la leit, bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin sa ïoh kynti ïa ka.
Te mynta, namarba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong shnong ha ri thor, lashai phin mih ban ïaid tawiar biang ïa ka ri kynjah na ka lynti kaba sha Duriaw Basaw.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses bad ha u Aron,
“Haduh lano keiñ une u paid bynriew bymman un kren khñium pyrshah ïa Nga? Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium ba ki paid Israel ki kren pyrshah ïa Nga.
Khie ïathuh ha ki, ‘Kumba Nga im, u Trai U ong, katkum ki ktien ba Nga la ïohsngew, Ngan sa leh ïa phi.
Ki met ïap jong phi kin sa kyllon ha kane ka ri kynjah; na kito baroh kiba phi la shim jingkheiñ, kiba phi la ñiew naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, kiba la kren khñium pyrshah ïa Nga,
wat uwei ruh un ym ïoh rung hapoh kata ka ri kaba Nga la kular ba Ngan sa pynshong shnong ïa phi, lait tang ïa u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne bad ïa u Joshwa u khun jong u Nun.
Hynrei ïa ki khun rit jong phi, kiba phi la ong hana kin sa shah rong noh, Ngan sa pynrung, bad kin sa tip ïa kata ka ri kaba phi la ibeiñ.
Hynrei shaphang jong phi te, ki met ïap jong phi kin sa kyllon ha kane ka ri kynjah.
Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin sa long ki nongap langbrot ha ri kynjah kumba sawphew snem, bad kin sa jynjar na ka bynta ka jingharam jong phi; haduh u bakhatduh kin sa ïap lut baroh ha ri kynjah.

Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki sngi ba phi la leit peit syntiat ïa kata ka ri ka la long sawphew sngi. Te ïa kawei kawei ka sngi yn sa ñiew kum shi snem; phin kit ïa la ka jingbymman sawphew snem, bad hangta phin sa tip ka mut aïu ban pynsngewsih ïa Nga.’
Nga, u Trai, Nga la kren; da shisha Ngan sa leh ïa kane ha une u paid u ba-atlukhi, uba la ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa Nga. Hangne ha ri kynjah kin sa ïap lut haban da lut phoiñ.”

Kita ki rangbah ïa kiba u Moses u la phah ban peit syntiat ïa kata ka ri, bad kiba, ynda ki la wan phai, ki la kynshoit ïa u paidbah baroh ban kren khñium pyrshah ïa u da kaba pynphriang ka khubor ka basniew shaphang kata ka ri,
kita ki rangbah kiba la wan rah ka khubor ka basniew shaphang kata ka ri, ki la ïap da ka khlam hakhmat u Trai.
Hynrei u Joshwa u khun u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun u Jephunne kiba la ïaleit ryngkat bad kito kiwei pat ki briew ban peit syntiat ïa kata ka ri, ki la lait ïap.
Te u Moses u la ïathuh ïa kine ki ktien ha ki paid Israel baroh, bad ki paidbah ki la ïam sngewsih shibun.

Kumta ki la khie dang step phyrngap, bad ki la leit kiew sha kliar kata ka ri lum, ki da ong, “Ñiuma, ngi la leh pop. Hynrei peit, ngi la ïawan hangne; ngin leit tur sha kata ka jaka kaba u Trai U la kular.”
U Moses u la ong, “Balei sha phi tamsneng ïa ka hukum u Trai? Phin ym lah ban jop!
Ieh wat leit tur, ïoh phi shah pom ei hakhmat ki nongshun jong phi, naba u Trai Um don bad phi.
Hangtei don ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan markhmat jong phi, bad phin sa kyllon da ka waitlam. Namarba phi la phai lyndet na u Trai, u Trai Un ym don lem bad phi.”
Hynrei ki la leh shlan ban leit tur sha kliar kata ka ri lum, bad khlem da don ka synduk jong ka jutang u Trai ne u Moses, ki la mih la ka mih na ka jaka dara.
Te ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan kiba la shong ha kata ka ri lum ki la wan tur bad ki la jop ïa ki, bad ki la beh ïa ki nadien haduh Horma.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To ong ha ki paid Israel, Ynda phi wan poi sha kata ka ri ba phi dei ban shong shnong, kaba Nga ai ha phi,

bad haba phi tyrwa ha u Trai na ki jynri ne na ka kynhun ’langbrot u jynkñia da ka ding ne u jynkñia thang ne kano kano ka jynkñia, ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular niam ne kum ka jynai sngewbha, ne haba long ki jingkhawai niam ba la buh-ïá, ban pynlong ka jingiwbih kaba pynsngewbha ïa u Trai,
uta uba wan rah jynkñia u dei ban tyrwa ha u Trai sa ka jingtyrwa jynbam shi bynta na ka shiphew bynta ka shi epha u moida u bani, ba la khleh lang bad shi pawa hin ka umphniang.
Nangta sa ka waiñ kum ka jingtyrwa jyndih, shi pawa hin, phi dei ban pynkhreh bad u jynkñia thang, ne na ka bynta ka jynkñia, ïa uwei uwei u khun ’langbrot.
Na ka bynta u ’langbrot, phi dei ban pynkhreh ka jingtyrwa jynbam ar bynta na ka shiphew bynta ka shi epha u moida bani ba la khleh lang bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka shi hin ka umphniang.
Na ka bynta ka jingtyrwa jyndih phi dei ban tyrwa shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka shi hin ka waiñ, kum ka jingiwbih kaba pynsngewbha ïa u Trai.
Haba phi pynkhreh u masi kyrtong kum u jynkñia thang, ne u jynkñia ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular niam, ne ban tyrwa jynsuk ha u Trai,
