baroh kaei kaei kaba lah ban shan ha ka ding, phin syaw ha ka ding bad hangta kan sa khuid. Lajar katta, dang dei ban pynkhuid ïa ka da ka um jingpynkhuid; hynrei ïa kaei kaei kabym lah ban shah ïa ka ding, phi dei ban phyrnop ha ka um.
Phi dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka sngi ka bahynñiew, bad phin sa khuid; te nadien kata phin sa wan hapoh jaka dara.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To shim jingkheiñ ïa kaba phi la ïoh knieh, la ka dei na u briew ne u mrad, ma phi bad u Eleasar lyngdoh lem bad ki rangbah jong ka ïing kpa tymmen jong u paidbah.
To bate ïa ka bai kliarwait ar bynta, hapdeng ki ’riewthma bad u paidbah baroh.
Phi dei ban buh ka khrong na ka bynta u Trai. Na ki ’riewthma kiba la leit thma, kawei na man la ki sanspah lada dei ki briew, ki masi, ki kada ne ki kynhun ’langbrot.
To shim ïa kata ka khrong na ka shiteng jong ki, bad to ai ïa ka ha u Eleasar lyngdoh kum ka jyntyrwa ha u Trai.

Na ka shiteng jong ki paid Israel phin shim kawei na man la ki sanphew, lada dei ki briew, ki masi, ki kada, ne ki kynhun ’langbrot kata na ki jynri baroh, bad to ai ïa ki ha ki Lebi kiba dei ban sumar ïa ka tabernakyl jong u Trai.”
Te u Moses bad u Eleasar lyngdoh ki la leh kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.
Te ka bai kliarwait kaba sah na kata kaba ki ’riewthma ki la ïoh kurup ka la long: hynriewspah hynñiewphew san hajar tylli ki ’langbrot,
hynñiewphew ar hajar ki jynri,
hynriewphew wei hajar ki kada,
bad laiphew ar hajar ngut ki samla kynthei basotti.
Ka shiteng jong kito kiba la leit thma ka la long ha ka jingkheiñ laispah laiphew hynñiew hajar sanspah tylli ki ’langbrot,
bad ka khrong kaba hap ha u Trai na ki ’langbrot ka la long hynriewspah hynñiewphew san tylli.
Ki jynri ki la long laiphew hynriew hajar; na kine ka khrong ïa u Trai ka la long hynñiewphew ar tylli.
Ki kada ki la long laiphew hajar sanspah tylli; na kine ka khrong ïa u Trai ka la long hynriewphew wei tylli.
Ki briew ki la long khathynriew hajar ngut; na kine ka khrong ïa u Trai ka la long laiphew ar ngut ki briew.
Te u Moses u la ai ïa ka khrong kaba hap ha u Trai ha u Eleasar lyngdoh, kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.
Ka shiteng kaba hap ha ki paidbah Israel, kaba u Moses u la bate na kata ka jong ki briew kiba la leit sha ka thma—
ka shiteng jong u paidbah ka la long laispah laiphew hynñiew hajar sanspah tylli ki ’langbrot,
laiphew hynriew hajar ki jynri,
laiphew hajar sanspah tylli ki kada,
bad khathynriew hajar ki briew.

Na ka shiteng jong ki paidbah Israel u Moses u la shim kawei na man la ki sanphew, lada ïa ki briew ne ki mrad, bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki Lebi kiba dei ban sumar ïa ka tabernakyl jong u Trai, kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.
Te ki rangbah pyrton jong ki hajar, ki kapten jong ki hajar, bad ki kapten jong ki spah ki la wan ïakynduh ïa u Moses,
bad ki la ong kumne ha u Moses, “Ki shakri jong phi ki la ñiew ïa ki ’riewthma kiba hapoh ka hukum jong ngi, bad ym don wat uwei u briew uba la jah na ngi.

Ngi la wan rah ka jyntyrwa ha u Trai, kat kiba uwei pa uwei u briew u la lap, ki mar kiba da ka ksiar, ki khadu kti, ki syngkha, ki sahti mohor, ki soh shkor, bad ki kpieng, ban pynïasuk na ka bynta ïa lade hakhmat u Trai.”
Te kumta u Moses bad u Eleasar lyngdoh ki la ïoh pdiang na ki ïa ka ksiar, ïa ki kynja jyndeng baroh.
Te ka ksiar baroh ba la tyrwa da ki rangbah pyrton jong ki hajar, bad da ki rangbah pyrton jong ki spah, ka la long khathynriew hajar hynñiewspah sanphew shekel.
(Ki ’riewthma ki la shim bai kliarwait man la u briew ïa lade lade.)

U Moses bad u Eleasar lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka ksiar na ki rangbah pyrton jong ki hajar bad jong ki spah, bad ki la wan rah ïa ka shapoh ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh, ban sah jingkynmaw ïa ki paid Israel hakhmat u Trai.

Ka la jia ba ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Gad ki la don shikatdei bah ki jynri jyndup. Ki la ïohi ba ka khyndew ha Jazer bad ka khyndew ha Gilead ka la long shisien peit ka jaka kaba ïadei bha ïa ki jynri.
Kumta ki khun ki ksiew u Gad bad ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben ki la wan bad ki la ong ha u Moses, ha u Eleasar lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah duh jong u paidbah,
“Ka Ataroth, ka Dibon, ka Jazer, ka Nimra, ka Heshbon, ka Eleale, ka Sebam, ka Nebo, bad ka Beon,
kata ka ri kaba u Trai U la jop hakhmat u paid Israel, ka long ka khyndew kaba ïadei bad ki jynri, bad ki shakri jong phi ki long kiba ri jynri.”
Te ki la ong, “Lada phi sngewsynei ïa ngi, to ai seh ba ki shakri jong phi kin dakhol ïa kane ka khyndew; wat ïalam ïa ngi sha shiliang ka Jordan.”
Hynrei u Moses u la jubab ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Gad bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben, “Dei mo ba ki hynmen para jong phi kin leit ïaleh thma, ma phi pat phin shong suk kynjai hangne?
Balei phin pynsyier ïa ki paid Israel ban leit tur sha kata ka ri kaba u Trai U la aiti ha ki?
Ki la leh kumne keiñ ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba nga la phah ïa ki na Kadesh-barnea ban wan jngoh ïa kata ka ri.
Haba ki la leit poi haduh ka Them Eshkol, ki la ïohi ïa kata ka ri, pynban ki la pynsyier ïa ka dohnud ki paid Israel ban leit tur sha kata ka ri kaba u Trai U la aiti ha ki.
Hangta u Trai u la bitar lep ha kata ka sngi, bad U la smai,

‘Da lei lei yn ym don uwei na ki briew kiba la mih na Ijipt uba naduh arphew snem ka ryta bad shaneng, uban ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba Nga la smai ban ai ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob, namarba kim shym la ngeit sneng ïa Nga nadong shadong;
yn ym don mano mano lait tang u Kaleb u khun u Jephunne u jait Ken, bad u Joshwa u khun jong u Nun, naba tang kine ki la ngeit sneng nadong shadong ïa u Trai.’
Te u Trai U la bitar lep ïa ki Israel, bad u la pynïaid wir ha ri kynjah sawphew snem, haduh ba la ïap-duh baroh ka pateng bynriew kaba la leh bymman hakhmat u Trai.
Hakhmih sa ma phi phi la mih ha ka jaka ki kpa tymmen jong phi, ki jait briew kiba da ka pop rynjaiñ, ban nang pyningkhong shuh shuh ïa u Trai Uba la bitar lep ïa ki Israel!
Hei! lada phi phai noh ban ym bud ïa U, Un ieh noh lyndet ïa phi ha ri kynjah, bad Un pynïap-duh ïa une u paid baroh.”
Te ki la wan ïakynduh biang ïa u Moses, bad ki la ong, “Ngin shna hangne tang ki sem ’langbrot na ka bynta ki kynhun ’langbrot jong ngi, bad ki shnong ban shong tang ki khun rit jong ngi.

Ngi te ngin kieng la ki tiar thma, ban leit ryngkat bad ki paid Israel, haduh ba ngin da ïalam ïa ki ha la ki jaka jaka; ki barit jong ngi te kin mat shong ha ki shnong ba la kerkut na ka daw ki trai shnong jong ka ri.
Ngin ym wan phai sha ïing lajong tat haduh ba ki paid Israel kin ïoh la ka bynta bynta.
Ngin ym ïoh bynta bad ki sha shiliang ka Jordan ne sha palat jong ka, namar ngi la ïoh la ka bynta shane sha shiliang ka Jordan shaphang mihngi.”
Kumta u Moses u la ong ha ki, “Lada phin leh kumne, lada phin kieng atiar ban leit hakhmat u Trai na ka bynta ka thma,
lada phi ki ’riewthma baroh phin leit sha shiliang ka Jordan hakhmat u Trai, haduh ba U la pynher krad ïa ki nongshun nakhmat jong U,
bad ka ri ka la dem hakhmat u Trai, te hadien kata phin sa leit phai bad phin sa lait na ka jingteh ha u Trai bad ha ki Israel, bad kane ka ri kan sa long ka nongkynti jong phi hakhmat u Trai.
Hynrei lada phin ym leh kumba phi ong, hei, phi la leh pap pyrshah u Trai; to tip skhem ba ka pap jong phi kan sa lap ïa phi.
To tei ïa kita ki shnong na ka bynta ki khun rit jong phi bad ïa ki sem na ka bynta ki ’langbrot jong phi; to leh ïa kata kaba phi la kular.”
Te ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Gad ki la ong ha u Moses, “Ki shakri jong phi kin leh thik kumba u kynrad jong ngi u hukum.
Ki khun rit jong ngi, ki tnga jong ngi, ki kynhun jong ngi, bad ki jynri jong ngi baroh, kin sah noh ha ki shnong ha Gilead,
hynrei ki shakri jong phi, man la u rangbah uba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma, un jam sha shiliang ban ïaleh hakhmat u Trai kumba u kynrad jong ngi u hukum.”
Kumta u Moses u la ai hukum shaphang jong ki ha u Eleasar lyngdoh, ha u Joshwa u khun u Nun, bad ha ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki jait Israel.

U Moses u la ong ha ki, “Lada ki khun ki ksiew u Gad bad ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben, man la u rangbah uba la kieng atiar thma ban ïaleh hakhmat u Trai, ki jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad kata ka ri ka pyndem hakhmat jong phi te to ai ba kin ïoh kynti ïa ka ri Gilead.
Hynrei lada kim jam sha shiliang ryngkat bad phi da kaba kieng atiar, ki dei ban ïoh bynta ryngkat bad phi ha ri Kanaan.”
Te ki khun ki ksiew u Gad bad ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben ki la phai ktien, “Kumba u Trai U la ong ha ki shakri jong phi, kumta keiñ ngin leh.
Ngin jam sha shiliang da kaba kieng atiar hakhmat u Trai sha ri Kanaan, hynrei ka bynta ba ngi dei ban ïoh kan sah bad ngi kato kaba sha lyndet ka Jordan.”

Te u Moses u la ai ha ki, ha ki khun ki ksiew u Gad, ha ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben, bad ha ka shiteng ka jait u Manasse u khun u Joseph, ïa ka hima jong u Sihon u syiem ki Amor bad ïa ka hima u Ok u syiem Bashan, ïa kata ka ri lem bad ki shnong kiba hapoh ki pud jong ka, bad ïa ki shnong baroh kiba sawdong jong kata ka ri.
Te ki khun ki ksiew u Gad ki la tei ïa ka Dibon, ka Ataroth, ka Aroer,
ka Atrothshophan, ka Jazer, ka Jokbeha,
ka Beth-nimra bad ka Beth-haran, ki shnong kiba la tei kut, bad ïa ki sem ’langbrot.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben ki la tei ïa ka Heshbon, ïa ka Eleale, ka Kiriathaim,
ïa ka Nebo, ka Baalmeon (la pynkylla kyrteng ïa ki), bad ïa ka Sibma. Ki la ai da kiwei pat ki kyrteng ïa ki shnong ba ki la tei.
Ki khun ki ksiew u Makhir, u khun u Manasse, ki la leit sha Gilead. Ki la jop ïa ka bad ki la beh krad ïa ki Amor kiba shong hangta.
Te u Moses u la ai ïa ka Gilead ha u Makhir u khun u Manasse, bad u la shong shnong hangta.
U Jair u khun u Manasse u la leit bad u la knieh ïa ki nongrit jong ki bad u la ai kyrteng ïa ki Habboth-jair.
U Noba u la leit bad u la knieh ïa ka Kenat bad ïa ki nongrit jong ka, bad u la khot ïa ka ka Noba katkum ka kyrteng lajong.
Kine ki long kita ki jingïaid lynti jong ki paid Israel kat kum ki por bad ki jaka haba ki la mih noh na ri Ijipt shi kynhun kynhun hapoh ka jingïalam jong u Moses bad u Aron.
U Moses u la buh jynthoh ïa ki jaka ba ki la mih, pateng pateng da ka hukum u Trai. Kine ki long pateng pateng kita ki jaka ba ki la mih:
ki la mih na Rameses ha u bnai u banyngkong, ha ka sngi ka bakhatsan jong u bnai u banyngkong. Kum lashai hadien ka Paskha ki paid Israel ki la mih da ka jingjop haba ïohi baroh ki Ijipt,
katba ki Ijipt ki dang tep ïa ki khun nyngkong jong ki baroh, ïa kiba u Trai U la shoh ïap hapdeng jong ki; ïa ki blei jong ki ruh u Trai U la tian bishar.
Kumta ki paid Israel ki la mih na Rameses bad ki la shong dara ha Sukkoth.
Ki la mih na Sukkoth, bad ki la shong dara ha Etham, kaba don harud ka ri kynjah.
Ki la mih na Etham, bad ki la phai dien sha Pihahiroth, kaba sha mihngi ka Baal-Zephon, nangta ki la shong dara ha pyrshah Migdol.
Ki la mih na mar pyrshah Hahiroth, ki la ïaid lyngba napdeng duriaw sha ri kynjah, nangta ki la ïaid lai sngi lynti ha ri kynjah Etham, bad ki sa shong dara ha Mara.

Ynda mih na Mara, ki la wan poi sha Elim; ha Elim la don khat-ar tylli ki umpohliew bad hynñiewphew tylli ki dieng tlai, te ki la shong dara hangta.10Ki la mih na Elim, bad ki la shong dara harud Duriaw Basaw.
Ynda mih na Duriaw Basaw, ki la shong dara ha ri kynjah Sin.
Ynda ki la mih na ri kynjah Sin, ki la shong dara ha Dophka.
Ki la mih na Dophka, bad ki la shong dara ha Alush.
Ynda ki la mih na Alush, ki la shong dara ha Rephidim, ha kaba ym shym don um satia ba ki paidbah kin dih.
Ki la mih na Rephidim, bad ki la shong dara ha ri kynjah Sinai.
Ynda ki la mih na ri kynjah Sinai, ki la shong dara ha Kibroth-hatta-aba.
Ki la mih na Kibroth-hatta-aba bad ki la shong dara ha Haseroth.
Ki la mih na Haseroth bad ki la shong dara ha Rithma,
Ki la mih na Rithma bad ki la shong dara ha Rimmon-peres.
Ki la mih na Rimmon-peres bad ki la shong dara ha Libna.
Ki la mih na Libna bad ki la shong dara ha Rissa.
Ki la mih na Rissa, bad ki la shong dara ha Kehelatha.
Ki la mih na Kehelatha, bad ki la shong dara ha lum Shepher.
Ki la mih na lum Shepher, bad ki la shong dara ha Harada.
Ki la mih na Harada bad ki la shong dara ha Makheloth.
Ki la mih na Makheloth, bad ki la shong dara ha Tahath.
Ki la mih na Tahath bad ki la shong dara ha Tera.
Ki la mih na Tera bad ki la shong dara ha Mithka.
Te ki la mih na Mithka, bad ki la shong dara ha Hashmona.
Ki la mih pat na Hashmona, bad ki la shong dara ha Moseroth.
Ki la mih na Moseroth, bad ki la shong dara ha Benejaakan.
Ki la mih na Benejaakan, bad ki la shong dara ha Hor-hakkidkad.
Ki la mih pat na Hor-hikkidkad, bad ki la shong dara ha Jotbatha.
Ki la mih na Jotbatha, bad ki la shong dara ha Abrona.
Ki la mih sa na Abrona, bad ki la shongdara ha Ezion-Geber.
Ki la mih na Ezion-Geber, bad ki la shong dara ha ri kynjah Zin (kata ka mut, ha Kadesh).
Te ki la mih na Kadesh, bad ki la shong dara ha lum Hor, ha khappud ka ri Edom.
Te u Aron u la leit kiew ïa u lum Hor da ka hukum u Trai bad u la ïap hangta, ha ka snem ka basawphew naduh ba ki paid Israel ki la mih na ri Ijipt, ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u basan.
U Aron u la dap shispah arphewlai snem ka ryta haba u la ïap halor u lum Hor.
Te u syiem Kanaan jong ka Arad uba la shong ha Nekeb ha ri Kanaan u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingwan ki paid Israel.
Ynda ki la mih na lum Hor, ki la shong dara ha Zalmona.
Te ki la mih na Zalmona, bad ki la shong dara ha Punon.
Ynda mih na Punon, ki la shong dara ha Oboth.
Ki la mih na Oboth, bad ki la shong dara ha Iye-Abarim, ha ki thaiñ Moab.
Te ki la mih na Iyim, bad ki la shong dara ha Dibon-Gad.
Ynda ki la mih na Dibon-Gad, ki la shong dara ha Almon-dibla-thaim.
Ki la mih na Almon-dibla-thaim, bad ki la shong dara ha ki lum Abarim mar pyrshah u Nebo.
Ynda ki la mih na ki lum Abarim, ki la shong dara ha ri thor Moab harud ka Jordan mar pyrshah ka Jerikho.
Ki la shong dara harud ka Jordan naduh Beth-Jeshimoth haduh Abel-shittim ha ri thor Moab.
Te u Trai U la kren ha u Moses ha ri thor Moab harud ka Jordan ha marpyrshah ka Jerikho,
“To ïathuh ha ki paid Israel: Ynda phi jam sha shiliang ka Jordan hapoh ri Kanaan,

phi dei ban beh krad ïa ki trai shnong baroh jong kata ka ri nakhmat jong phi, bad phi dei ban pynjot ïa ki dur maw, phi dei ban pynjot ïa ki dur blei jong ki baroh, phi dei ban pynpra ïa ki ïing blei ha lum.
Nangta phin sa dakhol ïa kata ka ri bad phin sa shong shnong ha ka, naba Nga la aiti ïa ka ha phi ba phin ïoh ei.

Phin sa ïabate ïa ka khyndew da kaba shu khalai nusib shikur shikur; ha ka jait ka baheh paid phin ai ka bynta ka baheh, bad ha ka jait ka barit paid phin ai ka bynta ka barit; kat kaba hap ha uno uno u briew da kaba khalai nusib, kata kan long ka jong u. To bate jaka katkum ki jait jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi.

Hynrei lada phim beh noh ïa ki trai shnong jong kata ka ri na khmat jong phi, kito kiba phi shah ban sah kin sa long kum ki speh ha ki khmat jong phi bad ki shiah ha ki krung jong phi. Kin sa pyndik ïa phi ha kata ka ri ba phi shong.
Te Nga ruh Ngan sa leh ïa phi kumba Nga la mut ban leh ïa ki.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To hukum ïa ki paid Israel, bad to ong ha ki: Ynda phi rung hapoh ka ri Kanaan (kane kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïoh bynta, ka ri Kanaan kaba la biang ki pud ki sam),
na shaphang shathie kan long naduh ka ri kynjah Zin na khap-pud Edom, bad u pud jong phi na shathie un long na bakut ka Duriaw Mluh shaphang mihngi.
Une u pud un phai na shaphang shathie ka rabab Akrabbim, nangta un pom lyngba sha Zin bad un kut shaphang shathie ka Kadesh-barnea; nangta un ïaid beit beit sha Hasar-addar, haduh Azmon.
Na Azmon u pud un phai sha ka wah duid ka Ijipt, bad un kut sbak ha duriaw.
“Kum u pud na sepngi, phin don ka Duriaw Bah bad ka rud duriaw jong ka; une un long u pud jong phi na sepngi.
“Na shaphang shatei une u pud jong phi: na ka Duriaw Bah phin thew dak sha u lum Hor;
na u lum Hor phin buh dak ïa u shaduh lynti khim Hamath, bad u pud un kut ha Zedad.
Nangta u pud un poi haduh Ziphron, bad un kut ha Hasar-enan. Une un long u pud na shaphang shatei.
“Phin buh dak ïa u pud jong phi uba na shaphang mihngi naduh Hasar-enan haduh Shepham;
na Shepham pat u pud un hiar sha Ribla, na ka liang mihngi jong ka ka Ain; nangta u pud un noh sharum haduh ban da poi ha ka ryngkew kaba sha mihngi jong ka duriaw Shinnereth.
U pud un leit arsut shaduh ka Jordan, bad un kut artat ha ka Duriaw Mluh. Kane kan long kata ka ri jong phi bad ki pud ki sam baroh sawdong.”

Te u Moses u la hukum ïa ki paid Israel u ong, “Kane ka long kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïoh bynta da kaba khalai nusib ïa kaba u Trai U la hukum ban ai ha ki khyndai jait bad ha ka shiteng ka jait Manasse.

Ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Reuben katkum ki ïing ki kpa tymmen jong ki bad ka jait jong ki khun ki ksiew u Gad katkum ki ïing ki kpa tymmen jong ki ki la ïoh la ka bynta, lem bad ka shiteng ka jait Manasse.
Ki ar jait bad ka shiteng ka jait ki la ïoh la ka bynta sha shiliang ka Jordan ha pyrshah Jerikho shaphang mihngi, na shaba mih ka sngi.”
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong kita ki briew kiba dei ban ïabate ïa kata ka ri ban ai la ka bynta bynta ha phi: u Eleasar lyngdoh bad u Joshwa u khun u Nun.
Na kawei kawei ka jait phin shim uwei u rangbah, ban bate ïa ka ri la ka bynta bynta.
Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong kita ki rangbah: Na ka jait u Juda: u Kaleb, u khun u Jephunne.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Simeon: u Shemuwel u khun u Ammihud.
Na ka jait u Benjamin: u Elidad, u khun u Shislon.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Dan, u rangbah dei u Bukki, u khun u Jokli.
Na ki khun ki kti u Joseph: na ka jait jong ki khun ki ksiew u Manasse u rangbah dei u Hanniel, u khun u Ephod.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Ephraim, u rangbah dei u Kemuwel u khun u Shiphtan.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Zebulun, u rangbah dei u Elisaphan, u khun u Parnak.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Issakhar, u rangbah dei u Paltiel, u khun u Assan.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Asher, u rangbah dei u Ahihud, u khun u Shelomi.
Na ka jait ki khun ki ksiew u Naphtali, u rangbah dei u Pedahel, u khun u Ammihud.
Kine ki long kita ki rangbah ïa kiba u Trai u la ai hukum ban bate la ka bynta bynta ïa ka ri Kanaan ha ki paid Israel.”
Te u Trai U la kren ïa u Moses ha ri thor Moab harud ka Jordan ha pyrshah Jerikho,
“To hukum ïa ki paid Israel ba kin ai shnong lem ïa ki Lebi ba kin shong na ka bynta ba ki la ïoh, bad phin ai ruh ki jaka bamphlang ïa ki sawdong kita ki shnong.
Kita ki shnong kin long ba kin shong kin sah, bad ki jaka bamphlang kin long na ka bynta ki jynri jong ki, na ka bynta ki kynhun jong ki bad na ka bynta ki mrad jong ki baroh.
Kita ki jaka bamphlang sawdong ki shnong ba phin ai ha ki Lebi kin heh kumba shihajar pruh baroh sawdong naduh ka kynroh jong ka shnong.

Te phin thew, na shabar ka shnong, arhajar pruh naphang mihngi, arhajar pruh na shaphang shathie, arhajar pruh na shaphang sepngi, bad arhajar pruh na shaphang shatei; ka shnong kan don ha marpdeng. Kane kan long ka khyndew bamphlang jong ki na ka bynta ki shnong jong ki.
Ki shnong ba phi ai ha ki Lebi kin long ki hynriew tylli ki shnong jakarieh, ha kiba phin shah ïa u kynja nongpynïap briew ban leit phet rieh, bad nalor kine phin ai sa sawphew ar tylli ki shnong.
Ki shnong baroh kiba phi dei ban ai ha ki Lebi kin long sawphewphra tylli, lem bad ki jaka bamphlang.

Shaphang kine ki nongbah ba phin ai na ka bynta kaba ki paid Israel ki la ïoh, phin shim shibun na ki jait kiba kham khraw, phin shim khyndiat na ki jait kiba kham rit; kawei kawei ka dei ban ai na ki shnong jong ka ha ki Lebi, katkum ka bynta ba ki la ïoh.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses,
“To ong ha ki paid Israel: Ynda phi jam sha shiliang ka Jordan sha ri Kanaan,
phi dei ban jied ki shnong kiba phin pynlong kum ki shnong jakarieh ïa lade, khnang ba u nongpynïap briew uba kum pynïap ïa uno uno u briew khlem da mut khnang, u lah ban leit rieh hangta.
Kita ki shnong kin long kum ka jakarieh na u nongpynhiar kput, khnang ba u nongpynïap briew un ym ïap shuwa ba un da shah tian bishar hakhmat u paidbah.
Kita ki shnong ba phi ai ki dei ban long hynriew tylli ki shnong jakarieh jong phi.
Phi dei ban ai lai tylli ki shnong sha lyndet ka Jordan, bad lai tylli ki shnong hapoh ri Kanaan, ba kin long ki shnong jakarieh.

Kine ki hynriew tylli ki shnong kin long ka jakarieh ïa ki paid Israel, ïa u nongwei nongar, bad ïa u soh shnong uba shong thap bad ki, khnang ba uno uno u briew uba pynïap ïa uno uno u briew khlem da mut khnang, un dup ïoh ban leit rieh hangta.
“Hynrei lada u tangon ïa u da u kynja tiar nar, haduh ba un da ïap, uta u long u nongpynïap briew; ïa u nongpynïap briew dei ban pynïap.
Lada u lynthem da u maw haduh ba u briew un daïap, bad uta u briew u la ïap shisha, uta u dei u nongpynïap briew; te ïa u nongpynïap briew dei ban shu pynïap.
Ne lada u tangon ïa u da u kynja dieng uba u briew u lah ban ïap, bad uta u briew ruh u la ïap shisha, uta u dei u nongpynïap briew. Ïa u nongpynïap briew dei ban shu pynïap.
Uba wad kput snam u dei ban pynïap hi ïa u kynja nongpynïap briew; lada u lap ïa u, u dei ban pynïap ïa u.
Lada u tangon ïa u namar ba u shun, ne lada u phalub kyndit ïa u da kaba ap thap, haduh ba un da ïap,
ne lada u shoh ïa u da kaba wad kput, haduh ba un da ïap, te ïa uta u nongshoh dei ban shu pynïap; u long u nongpynïapbriew. Uba wad kput snam un pynïap ïa u nongpynïap briew lada u lap ïa u.
“Hynrei lada u shoh ïa u kynsan kynsan khlem don kput ei ei, ne lada u phalup daei daei ïa u khlem da ap thap lypa,
ne u kawang da u maw uba lah ban pynïap ïa u briew, bad khlem poi peit ïa u, u la kawang ïa u da uta, haduh ba un da ïap, wat la um dei u nongshun jong u, bad um shym mut ban pynmynsaw ïa u;
te u paidbah un bishar ïa u nongpynïap briew bad ïa u nongwad kput snam katkum kine ki riti aiñ.

U paidbah un pyllait ïa u nongpynïap na ka kti jong u nongwad kput, bad un ïalam ïa u sha ka shnong jakarieh sha kaba u la leit phet. Un shong hangta haban da ïap u lyngdoh rangbah uba la ïoh jingpynsleh da ka umphniang bakhuid.
Lada jia ba u nongpynïap briew u leit ha kano re kano ka por shabar ki pud jong ka shnong jakarieh sha kaba u la wan phet,
bad u nongwad kput snam u lap ïa u shabar ki pud jong ka shnong jakarieh, bad u pynïap ïa uta u nongpynïap briew, un ym kit pop snam ei ei.

Naba uta u briew u dei ban sah hapoh kata ka shnong jakarieh haban da ïap u lyngdoh rangbah. Tang hadien ka jingïap jong u lyngdoh rangbah, u nongpynïap briew u lah ban leit biang sha la ka khyndew ka shyiap lajong.
“Kine kiei kiei ki dei ban long kum ka aiñ synshar bad ka riti aiñ ïa phi pateng la pateng ha ki jaka shong jong phi baroh.
“Lada uno uno u briew u pynïap briew, ïa uta u nongpynïap briew yn pynïap katkum ka sabut satar jong ki sakhi, hynrei yn ym pynïap ïa uno uno u briew halor ka sabut jong uwei u sakhi.
“Nalor nangta phim dei ban shim kuna na ka bynta ka jingim jong u nongpynïap briew, uba dei ban ïap; dei ban shu pynïap noh ïa u.
Phim dei ban shim kuna na uta uba la phet sha ka shnong jakarieh, khnang ba un dup ïoh leit phai sha la ka jaka shuwa ka jingïap u lyngdoh rangbah.

Phim dei ban pynbyrsieh ïa la ka ri ha kaba phi shong phi sah. Naba ka snam ka pynbyrsieh ïa ka ri, bad ym lah ban sait khuid daei daei ïa kata ka khyndew na ka bynta ka snam ba la pynphlei ha ka, lait tang da ka snam jong uta hi uba la pynphlei ïa ka.
Phim dei ban pynbyrsieh ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phi shong, ha kaba Nga hi Nga shong Nga sah, namar Nga u Trai Nga shong hapdeng ki paid Israel.”

Ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kpa tymmen kiba na ki ïingkur jong ki khun ki ksiew u Gilead u khun u Makhir, u khun jong u Manasse, kiba na ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki khun ki ksiew u Joseph, ki la wan ïakren bad u Moses bad ki khlieh duh, kiba long ki rangbah duh jong ki ïing kpa tymmen jong ki paid Israel.

Ki la ong: “U Trai U la hukum ïa u kynrad jong ngi ban bate ïa ka khyndew hapdeng ki paid Israel da kaba shu khalai nusib bad ïa u kynrad jong ngi la hukum da u Trai ban ai ïa ka nongtymmen u Zelophehad u hynmen jong ngi, ha ki khun kynthei jong u.

Lada ki shongkurim ïa uno uno u khun shynrang uba na kiwei pat ki jait Israel, te ïa ka bynta jong ki yn sa shim noh na ka nongtymmen ki kpa tymmen jong ngi. Kumta ka bynta jong kata ka jait kan roi; ka bynta ka nongtymmen jong ngi pat kan duna.

Te ynda poi ka jubili jong ki paid Israel, ïa ka nongtymmen jong ki yn sa kynthup lang ha ka bynta jong ka jait ba ki ïadei thana thaker. Kumta ïa ka bynta jong ki yn dkhat na ka nongtymmen jong ka jait ki kpa tymmen jong ngi.”
Hangta u Moses u la ai ka hukum ïa ki paid Israel katkum ka ktien u Trai. U la ong, “Ka jait jong ki khun ki ksiew u Joseph ka don ka hok.

Kane ka long kata kaba u Trai U la ai hukum shaphang ki khun kynthei jong u Zelophehad: ‘Ieh kine kin ïapoikha kat ïa kiba ki sngewdei; tangba ki dei ban ïapoikha hapoh ka ïingkur jong ka jait u kpa tymmen jong ki.
Ïa ka bynta jong ki paid Israel yn ym pynkynriah na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat, naba man la u khun u kti jong u paid Israel u dei ban snoh ha la ka nongtymmen jong ka jait ki kpa tymmen jong u.

Man la ka khun kynthei kaba ïoh bynta ha kano kano ka jait jong ki khun Israel kan long tnga ha ka ïingkur jong ka jait u kpa jong ka, kumta ba uwei pa uwei na ki khun Israel un dup ïoh tang ïa ka nongtymmen ki kpa tymmen la jong.
Ha kane ka rukom yn ym don nongtymmen kaban hap pynkynriah na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat. Kawei pa kawei ka jait jong ki khun Israel ka dei ban snoh ha la ka jong ka nongtymmen.’”
Kumta ki khun kynthei u Zelophehad ki la leh kumba u Trai U la hukum da u Moses.
Ka Mahla, ka Tirsa, ka Hokla, ka Mika bad ka Noa, ki khun kynthei u Zelophehad, ki la ïapoikha bad ki khun shynrang ki ’panah ’pasan jong ki.
Ki la shongkurim ha ki ïingkur jong ki khun shynrang u Manasse u khun jong u Joseph, bad kumta ka bynta jong ki ka la sah ha ka jait jong ka ïingkur u kpa jong ki.
Kine ki long kita ki hukum bad ki riti aiñ kiba u Trai U la hukum da u Moses ha ki paidbah Israel ha ri thor Moab harud ka Jordan marpyrshah Jerikho.
